articles.title: Patrick Mahomes’ son Bronze treats Taylor Swift like family in adorable resurfaced moment
articles.standfirst: A brief moment at Arrowhead Stadium has fans wondering just how close the Mahomes and Kelce families have become
articles.summary: A brief moment at Arrowhead Stadium has fans wondering just how close the Mahomes and Kelce families have become
articles.body:
A resurfaced video could offer a glimpse into the relationship between Patrick Mahomes’ family and Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift. Patrick and Travis have built a close friendship through their years with the Kansas City Chiefs, but his son Bronze may have revealed just how much their bond extends beyond the football field.

After nearly a decade of playing together, it would not be surprising if their families had grown close, too. Bronze’s reaction to seeing Swift suggests he recognizes her as someone familiar , even when she appears in one of her Eras Tour outfits.

A familiar face at Arrowhead

The moment took place when Patrick extended his contract with the Chiefs. His family was there to witness the career milestone , and they took the opportunity to walk through Arrowhead Stadium, the place that has been home to the quarterback throughout his NFL career.

As they made their way through the halls, Bronze spotted a photo of Swift from her Eras Tour stop at Arrowhead in Kansas City. He immediately recognized the singer and pointed her ou t, drawing attention to the connection fans believe exists between the two families.

Fans were quick to react to the moment, with many finding it adorable that Bronze recognized Swift so naturally. His response also fueled speculation that the Mahomes children may see the singer as an aunt-like figure , reflecting how close their family has become to the Kelces.

From Taylor Swift to Aunt Tay

The moment becomes even sweeter when compared with a story Travis and Jason Kelce shared about their own family. The Kelce girls initially referred to Swift by her full name, Taylor Swift, before gradually getting used to calling her Taylor or “Aunt Tay.”

While the Kelce children had to move away from using the singer’s full name, Bronze appeared to be comfortable recognizing her simply as Taylor. That small detail was enough to get fans talking about how familiar Swift may already be to Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ children .

articles.title: Taylor Swift is going to leave Travis Kelce, but she has a justifiable reason
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift could break a historic Chiefs streak, but not because of Travis Kelce: Hollywood is calling.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift could break a historic Chiefs streak, but not because of Travis Kelce: Hollywood is calling.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift is on track to miss Sunday’s game between the Kansas City Chiefs and the Los Angeles Chargers because she is scheduled to perform at the Academy Museum gala on Saturday night, according to an exclusive report from entertainment specialist Rob Shuter in his Naughty But Nice newsletter.

If her absence is confirmed, Swift would break a streak of 14 consecutive home games in which she has been present for the Chiefs since her first appearance at Arrowhead Stadium. The singer has not missed a Kansas City home game since December 8, 2024 , when she was unable to attend the matchup against the Chargers due to the final date of her Eras Tour in Vancouver.

Swift’s absence would have an impact that goes far beyond her relationship with Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce . Since she began her connection with the team in 2023, her presence has been linked to higher television ratings and an expansion of Kansas City’s fan base.

However, according to Shuter, the singer’s priority this weekend is advancing her goal of winning her first Oscar.

The Chiefs (4-0) will host the Los Angeles Chargers (0-5) this Sunday at 3:25 p.m. CT at Arrowhead Stadium in a Week 6 NFL matchup that will be broadcast on CBS following Kansas City’s bye week.

Taylor Swift’s historic relationship with Arrowhead

Swift first appeared at Arrowhead on September 24, 2023 , and quickly became a regular presence at Chiefs games.

During the 2024 season she attended nine of the team’s 10 home games, with her only absence coming against the Chargers because of the closing of her Eras Tour .

Since then, she has been present at every Kansas City home game, including the entire 2025 season and the first two home contests of this campaign.

According to various reports, Swift has attended at least 34 Chiefs games since she began her relationship with Kelce in 2023 , with Kansas City holding a 24-8 record in her first 32 games in the stands.

Sunday’s matchup would also mark her first missed home game since her wedding to Kelce on July 3, 2026, at Madison Square Garden.

“Taylor loves supporting Travis, but this weekend is about Taylor. He has his career. She has hers. And right now, hers involves winning an Oscar,” said a person close to the singer quoted by Shuter.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes could get unbelievable help in Super Bowl pursuit
articles.standfirst: Kansas City is exploring ways to strengthen its receiving corps, and the struggling wideout could emerge as a trade target before the deadline.
articles.summary: Kansas City is exploring ways to strengthen its receiving corps, and the struggling wideout could emerge as a trade target before the deadline.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs remain undefeated this season (4-0), but there is always room for improvement. Now, discussions have emerged about the possibility of upgrading their wide receiver group so Patrick Mahomes can continue elevating the level of the offense.

The Jauan Jennings move has not produced the expected results for the Minnesota Vikings . During the offseason, the franchise signed the veteran wide receiver to a one-year, $8 million contract to replace Jalen Nailor , who left the team in free agency.

However, Jennings has failed to establish himself as the reliable No. 3 receiver Minnesota was hoping for. Through four games, he has recorded just two receptions for nine yards, a disappointing return compared to the expectations surrounding his arrival.

With the NFL trade deadline approaching, Jennings’ future is becoming uncertain, and speculation is growing that the Vikings could look to move him to another team.

During the October 13 episode of “The Pat McAfee Show,” NFL insider Ian Rapoport said conversations surrounding a potential Jennings trade could increase over the coming days.

With that possibility on the table, several teams are emerging as potential landing spots. According to Devon Platana of Minnesota Vikings on SI , the Kansas City Chiefs could be an attractive destination for the receiver.

“The Chiefs are another team that likely wouldn’t mind some WR help. Entering Week 6, tight end Travis Kelce is the only Kansas City pass-catcher on pace to hit the 1,000-yard mark this season,” Platana wrote.

“Even though the Chiefs are undefeated, Patrick Mahomes clearly needs another weapon, especially as top WRs Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy are both averaging career lows in receiving yards per game at 47.5 and 33.3, respectively. Adding Jennings to the mix would be a huge gain for Mahomes, especially if the current Vikings wideout is motivated by a fresh start.”

Chiefs previously showed interest in Jauan Jennings

Kansas City’s previous interest in Jennings could become a key factor if the Vikings decide to listen to trade offers for the receiver.

Platana recalled that Adam Schefter of ESPN reported in May that the Chiefs were interested in signing Jennings before Minnesota ultimately won the race for his services.

“Knowing the Chiefs previously coveted him could also boost Jennings’ confidence, as ESPN’s Adam Schefter reported in May that the AFC West leaders were interested in signing him before the Vikings won the sweepstakes,” Platana added in his article.

Although his time in Minnesota has not started as expected, Jennings enters the trade market with a proven track record. During his five seasons with the San Francisco 49ers, he recorded 210 receptions, 2,581 receiving yards and 22 touchdowns in 75 games, making him an intriguing option for teams looking to strengthen their offense before the trade deadline.

articles.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current wants a brighter future for girls in soccer and is counting on thousands of fans to help break a record
articles.standfirst: The team’s October 25 match could become a citywide celebration of women’s soccer
articles.summary: The team’s October 25 match could become a citywide celebration of women’s soccer
articles.body:
T he Kansas City Current wants to turn its final regular-season home game into a moment fans and young players will remember. The club is aiming to bring together 18,000 supporters on October 25, when it faces the Washington Spirit. Brittany Mahomes , a former soccer player and one of the team’s founders, helped spread the word by sharing the announcement on Instagram.

The 18,000 goal does not mean packing that many people into CPKC Stadium. The club plans to welcome 12,000 fans inside the venue and another 6,000 at nearby Current Landing, where they can watch the match on outdoor screens. The team calls the event “One Current: Bigger Home. Bigger Future.”

Why this milestone means more to Brittany Mahomes

Mahomes’ connection to the event comes from her own time in the sport. She played college soccer and spent a year as a professional in Iceland before becoming a fitness entrepreneur and a founder of the Current. Patrick Mahomes has also said he wants his daughter to grow up knowing she can pursue her dreams in sports.

Forbes ranked the Current as the NWSL’s second-most valuable team in 2026, estimating its value had risen 18% in a year.

The match is also designed as a full day for the Kansas City community. Grounds passes start at $10, and the plans include a DJ, food trucks, games and activities.

The first 10,000 attendees across the stadium and Current Landing will receive a team flag ; after the match, fans can stay for a watch party for the Chiefs’ game against the Seattle Seahawks.

For the Current, the target is a chance to set a club attendance milestone and bring more people into women’s soccer. For Mahomes, who played the game before helping build a team around it, that crowd could also help make the sport’s next generation more visible. The club is asking Kansas City to show up and giving fans a chance to be part of that story.

articles.title: Travis Kelce provided intimate support to Taylor Swift in BTS look of "Patient Zero" video
articles.standfirst: Kelce and Swift are happy in love a few months removed from their epic wedding.
articles.summary: Kelce and Swift are happy in love a few months removed from their epic wedding.
articles.body:
When rumors began swirling that Taylor Swift had a new boyfriend, Swifties were eager to find out who it was that could capture her heart. Just about any potential beau would have seemed unlikely to many, but Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce being the guy was a true shock.

Kelce has dipped his toes in the entertainment industry in the past, but he's a football guy through and through. Now, a few years on since they began dating, the two are married and appear to be more in love than ever. The fire in their relationship isn't going down anytime soon.

That became clear once again this week, when a behind-the-scenes clip on the set of Swift's " Patient Zero " music video showed Kelce right behind her on the director's chair, showing his full support .

Kelce was smiling wide while Swift reviewed takes from the music video , which featured actors Colin Farrell and Dakota Johnson . The original video premiered on September 27 at the VMAs , right after Swift earned the inaugural Artist Director Honors at the awards show.

Kelce unfortunately wasn't able to attend the VMAs that night, since he was with the Chiefs in Florida to take on the Miami Dolphins . But he was there, behind the scenes, watching Swift's creative process unfold months prior .

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes may be raising the NFL’s next pass rusher at home if Brittany Mahomes agrees
articles.standfirst: Turning a family game into a playful question about the boy’s football future
articles.summary: Turning a family game into a playful question about the boy’s football future
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes’ week off from football was anything but quiet. As his children get older, the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback says, there is less time to lounge and more time keeping up with them. At home, that meant chasing after his son and getting tackled.

Mahomes said his 3-year-old, Patrick “Bronze” Mahomes III, loves to play tackle. The quarterback joked that his son brought him down throughout the week, then summed up the unexpected workout with a simple line: “I’m ready to go for this week.”

Could a future pass rusher be practicing on his dad?

The image is easy to picture: one of the NFL’s best quarterbacks trying to avoid a tiny pass rusher in his own living room . It makes for a fun headline, but Mahomes was describing playtime, not a plan to steer his son toward football. Bronze is still a toddler, and no one has said he wants to play the sport when he grows up.

Mahomes has said he wants his children to choose their own interests and would teach them football fundamentals without pressuring them to follow his path. Still, Bronze is growing up around the game, watching his dad play quarterback and already showing a love for tackling. If that interest stays with him, he could one day choose a very different position from his father’s. For now, the family can let him enjoy playing and see where his own choices lead.

A parent might feel proud to see a child love the game and still worry about the hits that come with football. But Brittany has not publicly said whether she would want her son to play, and there is no family decision to report.

Mahomes and Brittany are raising three children: Sterling, 5; Bronze, their only son and middle child; and Golden Raye, 1. Their young family is growing up around a sport that has defined Patrick’s life, but the quarterback has said he wants his children to find their own interests.

The Chiefs’ next game is Sunday, Oct. 18, against the Los Angeles Chargers at Arrowhead Stadium. Mahomes said he is ready to return after a week of getting tackled at home.

articles.title: Fed up with Taylor Swift in the NFL? Al Michaels criticizes the constant appearance of Travis Kelce's wife during Chiefs games
articles.standfirst: The veteran broadcaster believes television networks need to find the right balance between showing Taylor Swift in the stands and keeping the spotlight on the football
articles.summary: The veteran broadcaster believes television networks need to find the right balance between showing Taylor Swift in the stands and keeping the spotlight on the football
articles.body:
T aylor Swift 's connection to Travis Kelce has become one of the most discussed celebrity storylines in the NFL , but the attention she receives during broadcasts has not always been welcomed by football fans.

Now, veteran commentator Al Michaels has once again questioned how frequently television networks direct their cameras towards the global pop superstar during Kansas City Chiefs games.

Speaking on The Dan Patrick Show, Michaels reflected on the early stages of Swift's relationship with Kelce , when her presence at Chiefs games quickly became a major talking point for broadcasters and viewers alike.

While acknowledging the natural interest surrounding the couple, he argued that repeatedly showing the singer can become excessive.

“I think it did when all of a sudden she shows up, you know, it’s the beginning of the romance, and she’s showing up at the Kansas City games,” Al Michaels said on the Dan Patrick Show.

“And I think one time, I can’t remember which of the networks, she was on like 30 times. So, that’s a little much for anybody. So, you know, you got to pick your spots. You got to figure out how much is how much is too much. How much is not enough.”

The comments underline a familiar challenge for sports broadcasters. Swift's presence can attract viewers who might not otherwise follow the NFL closely, but excessive attention to a celebrity guest can frustrate those tuning in primarily for the competition.

For Michaels , the issue is not necessarily whether cameras should show Swift , but how often those shots interrupt the action.

The discussion also carries extra significance because Michaels has previously made clear that his own approach is to prioritise the game.

As one of the most recognisable voices in American football broadcasting, his comments offer a perspective from someone who has spent decades balancing live sports coverage with the wider stories surrounding major events.

From the Chiefs-Jets controversy to Michaels' moderation approach

The debate first intensified in October 2023, when Swift attended Kansas City's road game against the New York Jets at MetLife Stadium.

She watched alongside Brittany Mahomes and celebrities including Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively and Hugh Jackman as the Chiefs secured a victory.

The broadcast's repeated shots of Swift's suite quickly became a talking point. On the New Heights podcast, Jason Kelce cited an Associated Press report and noted that cameras had shown Swift at least 17 times during the game.

Travis Kelce acknowledged that the attention had become excessive, despite understanding why networks wanted to capture the celebrity guest.

“But at the same time, I think they’re overdoing it a little bit for sure, especially my situation,” Travis said.

Michaels had already offered a different approach when Swift attended Kansas City's game against the Denver Broncos on October 12, 2023.

Ahead of the broadcast on Amazon Prime Video, he explained that the production team had discussed how to handle her presence without distracting from the contest.

“What we’re gonna do (Thursday), everything in moderation,” Michaels said. “Our crew talked about it this morning. You can’t make a sideshow the show. The vast majority of the audience are tuning in to watch a football game. There are people, I don’t know how many; it could be a sizable number, but it’s certainly not a majority, that if you trained the camera on her all night long, they’d be satisfied with that. This is not what we’re doing to do.”

His approach reflected a simple principle: celebrity appearances can be part of the spectacle surrounding a major NFL game, but they should not replace the sporting event itself.

There is, however, another side to the discussion. Although repeated celebrity shots can feel excessive to some viewers, data from the AFC Championship Game between Kansas City and the Baltimore Ravens in January 2024 suggested that Swift's actual screen time was relatively limited.

Sports Illustrated reported that she appeared seven times for a combined 44 seconds during a broadcast lasting three hours and nine minutes. That represented approximately 0.39% of the total airtime.

The figures highlight the difference between how frequently viewers feel they see a celebrity and the amount of time that person actually occupies the broadcast.

Even brief appearances can become memorable when they are repeated across games and widely discussed on social media.

Swift's connection with Kelce has since become a major crossover story between music and professional football. Her appearances can introduce the Chiefs to new audiences, while the NFL benefits from attention generated outside its traditional sports coverage.

The Associated Press has previously reported that the league recognised the potential to attract younger viewers, including women, through the interest surrounding the couple.

That commercial appeal helps explain why cameras continue to find Swift when she attends games. But Michaels ' criticism raises a question for broadcasters: how can they acknowledge a story that matters to part of the audience without alienating viewers who want uninterrupted coverage of the action?

The answer may lie in the approach he advocated years ago. A handful of relevant shots can capture the atmosphere and acknowledge Swift's presence, while the bulk of the broadcast remains devoted to the players, coaches and pivotal moments on the field.

As the Chiefs continue their season, Swift's appearances are likely to remain a talking point whenever she is in attendance.

Michaels' message is not that she should never appear on screen. Rather, his argument is that networks need to exercise judgement, and remember that the football game remains the main event.

His approach reflected a simple principle: celebrity appearances can be part of the spectacle surrounding a major NFL game, but they should not replace the sporting event itself.

There is, however, another side to the discussion. Although repeated celebrity shots can feel excessive to some viewers, data from the AFC Championship Game between Kansas City and the Baltimore Ravens in January 2024 suggested that Swift's actual screen time was relatively limited.
Sports Illustrated reported that she appeared seven times for a combined 44 seconds during a broadcast lasting three hours and nine minutes. That represented approximately 0.39% of the total airtime.
The figures highlight the difference between how frequently viewers feel they see a celebrity and the amount of time that person actually occupies the broadcast.
Even brief appearances can become memorable when they are repeated across games and widely discussed on social media.

Swift's connection with Kelce has since become a major crossover story between music and professional football. Her appearances can introduce the Chiefs to new audiences, while the NFL benefits from attention generated outside its traditional sports coverage.
The Associated Press has previously reported that the league recognised the potential to attract younger viewers, including women, through the interest surrounding the couple.

That commercial appeal helps explain why cameras continue to find Swift when she attends games. But Michaels ' criticism raises a question for broadcasters: how can they acknowledge a story that matters to part of the audience without alienating viewers who want uninterrupted coverage of the action?

The answer may lie in the approach he advocated years ago. A handful of relevant shots can capture the atmosphere and acknowledge Swift's presence, while the bulk of the broadcast remains devoted to the players, coaches and pivotal moments on the field.
As the Chiefs continue their season, Swift's appearances are likely to remain a talking point whenever she is in attendance.
Michaels' message is not that she should never appear on screen. Rather, his argument is that networks need to exercise judgement, and remember that the football game remains the main event.

articles.title: Brothers Travis and Jason Kelce have increased Garage Beer's capital by $20 million and are preparing to expand into new markets
articles.standfirst: The NFL brothers' beer business has secured a $20 million revolving credit facility from Tiger Finance
articles.summary: The NFL brothers' beer business has secured a $20 million revolving credit facility from Tiger Finance
articles.body:
T ravis and Jason Kelce are continuing to build their business portfolio away from football, with Garage Beer securing a new $20 million financing agreement designed to support its next stage of growth.

The Columbus, Ohio-based light beer company has obtained a revolving credit facility from Tiger Finance as it prepares to enter additional markets and develop its product offering.

The deal, announced in October 2026, gives Garage Beer access to credit that can be drawn upon as needed, rather than providing a one-off cash injection in exchange for an ownership stake. The arrangement is intended to help the company finance its expansion while maintaining flexibility as its operations grow.

Garage Beer has attracted attention partly because of the involvement of the Kelce brothers, whose profiles in the NFL and wider entertainment industry have helped raise the brand's visibility.

However, the new agreement also reflects the company's development into a business that requires more than celebrity recognition to sustain its ambitions. Distribution, marketing, product development and relationships with retailers will all play important roles in its next phase.

Patrick Khayat , co-founder and partner of Durational Capital Management, highlighted the importance of the arrangement in a statement about the deal.

“We appreciate Tiger's creativity and partnership to structure a credit facility that leverages the strength of Garage Beer's brand to support the Company's growth objectives,” Khayat said.

He added that Tiger Finance was a debt partner Durational had worked with previously and that the companies looked forward to expanding the relationship as Garage Beer broadened its product line and entered new markets.

The financing comes after a significant investment in the business in 2025, when Durational Capital Management became a major shareholder alongside existing owners and operators Travis Kelce, Jason Kelce and founder Andy Sauer .

That earlier transaction provided resources for marketing, sales recruitment and nationwide expansion, establishing a stronger foundation for the company's ambitions.

Why the $20 million deal matters for the Kelce brothers' beer business

The new facility is particularly notable because it uses debt financing rather than another equity investment. A revolving credit line allows a company to access funds when required and repay amounts as its cash flow permits, subject to the agreement's terms.

This can be useful for consumer businesses dealing with changing inventory needs, production costs and the expense of entering unfamiliar markets.

Tiger Finance specialises in asset-based lending, which can take account of assets such as inventory, receivables, equipment and other eligible business assets. The arrangement gives Garage Beer another potential source of working capital as it seeks to grow.

The $20 million figure represents the size of the credit facility, however, and should not be interpreted as a direct increase in the company's valuation or proof that the full amount has already been drawn.

The move follows Garage Beer 's September 2025 strategic investment from Durational. At the time, the company said the funding would support greater marketing activity, strengthen its sales force and field resources, and deepen relationships with distributors, retailers and customers across the country.

The company also brought experienced figures from the beer industry onto its board, including Bill Hackett , the former chairman and president of Constellation Brands' beer division, and Rich Pascucci , formerly chief growth officer at Pabst Blue Ribbon.

Their experience provides additional industry knowledge as Garage Beer works to scale its operations.

Garage Beer currently focuses on a straightforward product proposition. Its Classic and Lime varieties are both listed at 4% alcohol by volume, with 95 calories and three grams of carbohydrates per serving.

The brand's uncomplicated identity and light-beer positioning are intended to appeal to consumers looking for an accessible alternative within a competitive category.

The Kelce brothers' involvement gives the company a marketing advantage that many emerging beer brands cannot easily replicate. Travis remains a prominent NFL tight end, while Jason built his reputation as a longtime Philadelphia Eagles centre before retiring and expanding his media work.

Their combined audience and public visibility provide a platform for promoting Garage Beer , but continued growth will depend on turning that attention into repeat purchases and reliable distribution.

Tiger Finance senior managing director Andy Cerussi also praised the brothers' role in building awareness for the brand.

“We are thrilled to have been chosen by Durational and the Company as their preferred financing partner,” Cerussi said.

“We have the highest confidence in Durational's ability to further the growth and scale of the business and are impressed with impact the Kelce brothers have had on positively influencing brand awareness.”

The challenge now is to translate the company's momentum into sustainable expansion. Entering new markets requires dependable supply, retailer support, local distribution and marketing that resonates beyond the Kelces' existing fan base.

A broader product range could offer additional ways to reach consumers, but it also brings operational demands and the need to manage inventory carefully.

For Travis and Jason Kelce , the $20 million credit facility marks another step in developing Garage Beer beyond its Midwest roots. The agreement does not guarantee success, but it provides the business with greater financial flexibility as it pursues its next phase.

With Durational's investment behind it and Tiger Finance supplying a new lending facility, Garage Beer is positioning itself to compete for a larger share of the American light-beer market.

articles.standfirst: The Chiefs are facing a major offensive concern as Rashee Rice continues to miss practice with a hamstring injury, putting his availability for Sunday’s matchup in serious doubt.
articles.summary: The Chiefs are facing a major offensive concern as Rashee Rice continues to miss practice with a hamstring injury, putting his availability for Sunday’s matchup in serious doubt.
articles.body:
Kansas City Chiefs face a potential offensive setback ahead of Week 6 after Rashee Rice missed consecutive practices with a hamstring injury.

The star wide receiver left the team’s Week 4 game against the Las Vegas Raiders after suffering the injury. Although the Chiefs had a bye the following week, updates on his recovery have not been encouraging.

Kansas City offered few details on its top receiver during the bye. The situation grew more concerning on Wednesday when the team confirmed Rice did not practice. Thursday brought no improvement.

Rashee Rice raises concerns after missing two practices

The Chiefs’ Thursday injury report listed Rice as a non-participant for the second straight day. Several other players were limited:

“Josh Simmons, L’Jarius Sneed and Peter Woods had limited participation in today’s practice. Rashee Rice did not practice, ” the team announced on social media.

Kansas City has not yet confirmed whether Rice will be available for Sunday’s game against the Los Angeles Chargers . Missing two consecutive practices with a soft-tissue injury, however, significantly raises doubts about his availability.

Who could replace Rashee Rice?

Rice’s potential absence would be even more problematic if Tyquan Thornton is also sidelined. Thornton has been one of the Chiefs’ primary deep threats.

In the game against the Raiders , Xavier Worthy and Thornton accounted for virtually all of the production among wide receivers. No other wideout recorded a catch. The rest of the passing game leaned heavily on tight ends Travis Kelce and Noah Gray , along with running backs Emmett Johnson and Kenneth Walker II , who combined for just 12 receiving yards.

If Rice is unable to play, Kansas City could turn to Jalen Royals and Cyrus Allen . Allen stood out during training camp and the preseason. Another option for head coach Andy Reid would be increased use of two-tight-end formations, leveraging the experience and reliability of Kelce and Gray to offset the thinner wide-receiver group.

Rice’s status remains under evaluation. Friday’s injury report will be critical in determining whether the receiver can suit up or whether the Chiefs will need to adjust their offensive plan against the Chargers.

articles.title: Eric Bieniemy reveals truth behind heated sideline clash with Patrick Mahomes
articles.standfirst: Eric Bieniemy finally addressed his intense sideline moment with Patrick Mahomes.
articles.summary: Eric Bieniemy finally addressed his intense sideline moment with Patrick Mahomes.
articles.body:
Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy dismissed any communication issues with Patrick Mahomes following their heated exchange during the team’s Week 4 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders .

Bieniemy said he not only accepts his players expressing frustration but considers that trust an important part of the coach-player relationship.

“I have no problems with guys venting their frustrations, because I want them to,” Bieniemy told reporters. “That’s part of the dynamic of the relationship that we have… if there’s something that’s taking place out on the field, they may have a better point of view than what we do from off the field, and so I want them to feel comfortable coming to share that stuff with me.”

Eric Bieniemy downplays discussion with Patrick Mahomes

Regarding the sideline moment with Mahomes, Bieniemy explained that he simply wanted to understand the quarterback’s frustration.

“At that particular time, I’m pretty sure I had asked, ‘Hey, man, what’s going on? Is everything okay?’”

Television cameras captured Mahomes speaking intensely with Bieniemy after Kansas City’s final offensive possession before halftime ended in a field goal that tied the game rather than a touchdown that would have given the Chiefs the lead.

The Chiefs settled for a 28-yard field goal after Mahomes failed to complete a pass to tight end Noah Gray on third-and-goal.

“There’s so many errors that take place throughout the case of a game, and hell, I’ve probably cussed somebody out about something,” Bieniemy added. “But that stuff, it happens, and not that you ever take anything personally.”

The Raiders took a lead into halftime with another field goal, but Kansas City mounted a comeback after Kenneth Walker III recovered a loose ball and scored the game-winning touchdown in the fourth quarter.

Chiefs looking to improve in the red zone

Despite their perfect start to the season, Kansas City still has areas to clean up — particularly converting scoring opportunities into touchdowns.

The Chiefs rank 14th in the NFL in red-zone touchdown efficiency at 63 percent through Week 5.

This is not the first time Mahomes and Bieniemy have had an intense in-game conversation. The quarterback has previously drawn attention for similar exchanges with the offensive coordinator, who returned to the role this season after holding the position from 2018 to 2022 .

The win over the Raiders allowed Kansas City to enter its bye week as one of only three remaining undefeated teams in the NFL.

The Chiefs will now look to maintain the momentum from their 4-0 start when they host a Chargers team that is still winless and ranks second-to-last in the league in passing yards.

articles.title: Travis Kelce catches Patriots receiver stealing his entire playing style: 'I like it'
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce praises Patriots rookie Efton Chism after his creative trick play against the Raiders
articles.summary: Travis Kelce praises Patriots rookie Efton Chism after his creative trick play against the Raiders
articles.body:
Travis Kelce has spotted a familiar touch of improvisation in New England Patriots wide receiver Efton Chism , and the Kansas City Chiefs star has some valuable advice for the young player after watching him pull off an unconventional play.

Chism grabbed attention during the Patriots’ emphatic 45-17 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders. Facing third-and-11 in the second quarter, quarterback Drake Maye connected with Chism on a short pass.

Instead of trying to gain yards himself, the receiver immediately flipped the ball to running back TreVeyon Henderson , who advanced far enough to secure a first down.

The sequence reminded Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel of Kelce’s unpredictable approach to football. Speaking on The Greg Hill Show after the game, Vrabel joked that Chism was “acting like Kelce” because he appeared to make things up as he went along.

Kelce and his brother Jason subsequently watched the highlight on their New Heights podcast, giving the Chiefs tight end an opportunity to assess the play and share his thoughts.

“I like it,” Kelce said, praising Chism for understanding the defensive alignment and recognizing where his teammates were positioned.

Kelce offers Patriots receiver advice after creative play

Kelce suggested that Chism should direct the lateral toward Henderson’s upfield shoulder rather than throwing the ball farther backward across the field.

"Third-and-11, knowing where the ball players are, 'you guys got me but don't got him.' Easy first,” Kelce added.

“You keep it on this upfield shoulder though, bud. You keep it on his upfield shoulder. You think you got to, like, throw it back. But really, you just got to throw it down the line. That way you can keep him running and get him another nice head start.”

Despite the technical suggestion, Kelce was clearly impressed with the receiver’s instincts and willingness to think creatively under pressure.

“It's good stuff though. I like where this kid's head's at. He's a ball player,” Kelce said, expressing his approval of Chism’s approach .

According to reporting from Pats Pulpit, Vrabel clarified that the lateral was designed by the coaching staff rather than being an entirely spontaneous decision by Chism . Although the play looked improvised, it was part of the team's preparation.

Chism also contributed to an impressive offensive performance against Las Vegas, finishing with five receptions for 57 yards. Maye delivered an outstanding performance of his own, recording 374 passing yards and five total touchdowns as New England secured a convincing win.

Meanwhile, Kelce’s future beyond football is becoming an increasingly popular topic of discussion. NFL commentator Mike Florio has suggested that CBS, ESPN and Amazon Prime Video could compete to secure the Chiefs star as a broadcaster in 2027.

Kelce already has considerable media experience through his New Heights podcast, which he co-hosts with Jason . That existing platform, combined with his personality and football knowledge, could make him an appealing addition to a major broadcasting team.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes focuses only on the Chiefs and his children suffer the consequences
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City quarterback is fully immersed in the NFL season, but his intense preparation has led to one relatable parenting slip-up
articles.summary: The Kansas City quarterback is fully immersed in the NFL season, but his intense preparation has led to one relatable parenting slip-up
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes is accustomed to managing enormous expectations on the football field, but even a three-time Super Bowl MVP can lose track of things away from the game.

With the Kansas City Chiefs preparing for another important stretch of their season, the quarterback admitted that his focus on football had caused him to overlook a major event at home: Halloween.

Mahomes and his wife, Brittany , have three young children: Sterling , 5, Bronze , 3, and Golden , 21 months.

With Halloween approaching, families across the United States are preparing costumes and celebrations, but the Chiefs star acknowledged that the occasion had barely crossed his mind.

“It surprised me. I forgot about Halloween,” Mahomes said. “Brittany was like what are gonna be for Halloween and I’m like, I didn’t even think about that. I’m so locked in on this week and the season and stuff.”

The admission offers a glimpse into the demands of an NFL season, when preparation can dominate a player's schedule. For Mahomes , the pressure is particularly significant as Kansas City pursues success and works to maintain its competitive standards.

His comments do not suggest that he has neglected his children, but they do illustrate how easily family plans can slip down the priority list when professional responsibilities take over.

Fortunately, Brittany appears to have the Halloween arrangements under control, leaving the quarterback to concentrate on football while the family decides on costumes.

When asked what the children would wear, Mahomes kept the details secret.

“I can’t tell now,” Mahomes said. “There’s options because you never know with kids, so we have multiple options. I don’t even know yet. I just know a couple of the options.”

Mahomes' commitment to Kansas City leaves little room for distractions

Mahomes ' Halloween oversight comes during a demanding period for the Chiefs . The quarterback has been working to maintain the team's momentum while preparing for changes within the receiving corps, with injuries to Tyquan Thornton and Rashee Rice creating additional challenges ahead of the Week 6 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers .

Mahomes has expressed confidence in younger options Cyrus Allen and Jalen Royals , who could be asked to take on larger roles.

“Just be ready; they’ve put in the work,” he told reporters.

“They’ve had to put in the work at practice, and they’ve been doing that. Now when their number gets called, they’re going to step into a role and do their job. I’m excited for them. We’ll put them in position to succeed. I have a lot of trust in those guys, a lot of confidence in them.”

That preparation reflects the attention required to keep Kansas City's offense functioning when familiar options are unavailable.

Developing timing with receivers takes repetition, communication and hours of practice, making it understandable that Mahomes ' thoughts remain firmly on the upcoming game.

His workload has also been shaped by rehabilitation following an ACL tear suffered in December 2025. Recovering from such a significant injury requires discipline, while returning to the demands of professional football adds another layer of responsibility.

Brittany Mahomes has played a crucial role at home

Mahomes has openly acknowledged how much his wife's support has meant during his recovery.

Speaking with Mitch Holthus on The Chiefs Kingdom Show at Arrowhead earlier this month, he praised Brittany for taking on additional responsibilities while he spent long hours rehabilitating.

“I think that that was something that’s huge for me because, she had being a mom to three, I mean, she had to kind of take on that role on even more because I wasn’t at the house. I was spending seven hours a day over there in the offseason when we’re supposed to be on vacation or back home in Texas,” he said.

“It’s a full commitment from the full family, and I think she did a great job of kind of being that leader of the household when I was having to be in the rehab facility.”

Brittany subsequently shared a clip of his comments on Instagram Stories, responding: “Would do anything for my babies and my husband.”

The exchange highlights the shared effort required to balance professional sport and family life. While Mahomes concentrates on leading Kansas City, Brittany has helped keep things running at home, including the preparations for Halloween.

Ultimately, forgetting about costumes is a relatively minor mistake, but it provides a relatable look at the challenges facing a professional athlete with three young children.

Mahomes ' football commitments may dominate his attention during the season, yet his appreciation for Brittany's support makes clear that he recognizes the sacrifices his family makes alongside him.

articles.standfirst: Kansas City, unbeaten and hurting, seeks revenge against its divisional nemesis
articles.summary: Kansas City, unbeaten and hurting, seeks revenge against its divisional nemesis
articles.body:
The NFL Week 6 gives us a matchup that blends divisional business and bitter memory. The Kansas City Chiefs , the only survivors of the AFC West with a perfect record, host the Los Angeles Chargers who are living the opposite side of the season: zero wins and the worst locker-room streak in their own division.

It will be a Sunday of brutal contrasts at Arrowhead, but with one ingredient that takes away any sense of a decided game: the Chargers swept the Chiefs in both of their meetings last season.

What time and where to watch the game between Chiefs vs Chargers?

The table tells a story without nuance. Kansas City leads the AFC West at 4-0 (4 played, 4 won), with 118 points for and 77 against, for a +41 differential that also puts it at the top of the entire league. It is the only NFL franchise that still does not know defeat at this stage.

Across from them, the Chargers are sinking the division with a dismal 0-5, last in the West and third from the bottom among all 32 teams (30th place). They have scored just 84 points and allowed 129, with a -45 point differential.

Their run in 26/27 has been a succession of stumbles: they fell to Arizona (14-26), Las Vegas (14-26), Buffalo (16-24), Seattle (23-30) and, in the previous round, at home against Denver (17-23). Five games, five losses, and a defense that can't find a way to stop anyone.

The Chiefs, by contrast, come in with four straight wins: Denver (31-10), Indianapolis (33-30), Miami (24-10) and, in Round 4, a tight 30-27 victory over Las Vegas. Kansas City did not play Round 5, hence it has one fewer game than most.

The featured showdown: Kansas City's unfinished business

Here's the intrigue. Last season, the Chargers won both matchups against the Chiefs: 27-21 in the season opener and 16-13 in Week 15, the latter no less than at Arrowhead.

That is, Los Angeles knows how to make Kansas City uncomfortable even in its own fortress. To make matters worse, that Week 15 result was part of the Chiefs’ bitterest closing stretch in recent years, a losing streak that sank their end of the season.

The question this Sunday is whether that psychological edge survives the change in context. The 2026 Chargers are not the same as they were back then: they have lost every game they have played, and their offense averages fewer than 17 points per game.

By contrast, the Chiefs display the balance they had been missing: they are averaging nearly 30 points per game and a defense that has already delivered containment performances such as the 24-10 win over Miami.

The natural script dictates local dominance. But divisional football doesn't understand linear logic, and the Chargers have the rare privilege of having solved the Chiefs in three of the last... well, two head-to-head games. Arrowhead doesn't scare them.

A win would cement Kansas City as the favorite in the AFC West and keep it among the contenders for the conference’s top seed , battling for prime positions alongside the unbeaten San Francisco 49ers and Minnesota Vikings, and one step behind the also formidable Jacksonville Jaguars, Buffalo Bills, and Baltimore Ravens. Every win without a loss is pure gold when it comes to the playoff order.

For the Chargers, the math is more urgent than ambitious: at 0-5, another loss would virtually leave them out of the divisional race before reaching the midpoint of the campaign . They are in total alarm mode, joined at the bottom of the league by the Miami Dolphins and Tennessee Titans, the other two winless teams.

Forecast for today's Kansas City Chiefs vs LA Chargers

Everything points to Kansas City. The contrast between 4-0 and 0-5 is too wide, and Mahomes' offense has what it takes to overwhelm the most porous defense in the division. That said, recent history calls for caution: the Chargers already won at Arrowhead last season, and Herbert is capable of keeping his team close.

The prediction is a Chiefs victory, with the home team asserting its favoritism and, in the process, exacting revenge for the two setbacks of 2025/26.

articles.title: Chiefs' Tyreek Hill reunion in doubt as potential NFL suspension complicates Patrick Mahomes' plans
articles.standfirst: The former All-Pro's knee injury, contract expectations and possible league punishment have complicated hopes of a return to Arrowhead
articles.summary: The former All-Pro's knee injury, contract expectations and possible league punishment have complicated hopes of a return to Arrowhead
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes could use another proven playmaker in the Kansas City Chiefs offense, but the possibility of reuniting with Tyreek Hill has become far more complicated than simply agreeing on a contract.

The Chiefs have reportedly maintained contact with their former receiver, whose explosive speed helped define one of the NFL's most dangerous offenses during his first spell in Kansas City.

However, Hill 's recovery from a serious knee injury, uncertainty surrounding his financial demands and the possibility of NFL discipline have left the organization hesitant to pursue an immediate deal.

The situation comes as Kansas City faces mounting problems at wide receiver, with Tyquan Thornton sidelined by an ankle injury and Rashee Rice dealing with a hamstring problem.

Chiefs reportedly reconsider Tyreek Hill reunion

NFL insider Jonathan Jones reported that Kansas City is exploring alternatives rather than moving quickly to bring Hill back.

"As it stands now, I don't get the sense the Chiefs are in a rush to sign Tyreek Hill," Jones wrote in The Athletic.

The Chiefs could instead increase opportunities for younger receivers while assessing potential trades before the November 10 deadline.

"I would expect the Chiefs to lean on a young receiver such as Jalen Royals in the short term as the team continues to sniff around the wide-receiver trade market," Jones explained.

"If Kansas City deals for a speedy receiver before the Nov. 10 deadline, I would take that as a negative development for a Hill reunion."

Jones also identified several unresolved obstacles, including the condition of Hill 's knee and the salary he would expect from his next team.

"The health of Hill's knee is one factor. The money will be another, as no one expects him to sign a veteran minimum deal. And then there's the potential NFL discipline," Jones added.

Hill faces possible NFL discipline after civil verdict

The uncertainty surrounding Hill 's future intensified following a civil trial involving his estranged wife, Lakeeta Vaccaro .

On October 13, a Miami jury found Hill liable on two battery claims and awarded Vaccaro $500,000 in compensatory damages.

The jury rejected eight other claims and awarded no punitive damages. The verdict was a civil finding, rather than a criminal conviction.

The NFL has confirmed that Hill remains under review through its Personal Conduct Policy, although no disciplinary decision has been announced.

NFL insider Jordan Schultz suggested that any potential suspension could arrive before Hill agrees to a contract.

"I don't know if anything with Tyreek is necessarily imminent, I just don't," Schultz said on the Ross Tucker podcast.

"I think the legal process is going to play out, and he needs to be, in my opinion, it's more likely he's suspended first before he signs."

Chiefs prepare younger receivers

Hill 's physical condition presents another obstacle after he suffered a dislocated knee and multiple ligament injuries, including a torn ACL, while playing for the Miami Dolphins last season.

Released by Miami in February, the veteran receiver has been working toward a possible November return, although his fitness for competitive action remains uncertain.

Kansas City could instead rely on Jalen Royals and Cyrus Allen as the coaching staff searches for solutions to its depleted receiving corps.

Offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy has made clear that both players will be expected to contribute when given opportunities.

"These guys [Allen and Royals] have the opportunities to get reps," Bieniemy said. "We expect them to go out and be who we expect them to be."

The Chiefs haven't publicly ruled out signing Hill , but with several obstacles unresolved, a reunion remains a possibility rather than an imminent move.

articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift returned to Arrowhead to support Travis Kelce, but the night quickly turned tense after the Chiefs star suffered an injury.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift returned to Arrowhead to support Travis Kelce, but the night quickly turned tense after the Chiefs star suffered an injury.
articles.body:
T aylor Swift was once again the center of attention at Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday, October 18, as she attended the game to support her husband , Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce , during the matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers.

The singer arrived in Kansas City after a quick trip from Los Angeles and watched the game from a suite at the stadium, where she was joined by longtime friend Este Haim and WNBA star Caitlin Clark , according to TMZ.

However, the day took a concerning turn when Kelce suffered a right ankle injury just minutes into the game.

The Chiefs tight end briefly left the field after showing discomfort and was attended to by the team’s medical staff on the sideline. CBS cameras captured the veteran player removing his shoe while trainers examined the injured area.

After receiving treatment and having his ankle taped, Kelce returned to the field in an attempt to continue playing, although Kansas City did not immediately provide details on the severity of the injury.

Travis Kelce raises concerns with injury against Chargers

The injury occurred during the opening minutes of the matchup between the Chiefs and Chargers , an AFC West divisional showdown.

Former NFL team doctor David Chao analyzed video of the play and suggested the injury could be a mild high ankle eversion sprain.

“By video, mild right high eversion ankle sprain,” Chao wrote on social media.

Kelce received initial treatment on his ankle before returning to the medical staff for additional support and a stronger wrap on the outside of his shoe.

The injury came at an important moment for Kansas City, which entered the matchup with a perfect 4-0 record on the season.

Taylor Swift arrives at Arrowhead after Hollywood event

Swift’s appearance in Kansas City came less than 24 hours after she attended the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles.

The singer was one of the biggest stars at Saturday night’s event, where she performed several songs from her catalog, including “Blank Space,” “Love Story,” and “The Fate of Ophelia.”

She also walked the red carpet wearing a Dior gown.

Kelce did not attend the gala with Swift as he was focused on preparing for Sunday’s game against the Chargers.

Despite her commitment in California and the cross-country travel, Swift made it to Arrowhead Stadium in time to support her husband in one of the most anticipated games of the season.

articles.standfirst: With Taylor Swift watching from the suite, Travis Kelce left the field in pain after suffering an ankle injury scare. The Chiefs star’s return provided relief after a tense few minutes.
articles.summary: With Taylor Swift watching from the suite, Travis Kelce left the field in pain after suffering an ankle injury scare. The Chiefs star’s return provided relief after a tense few minutes.
articles.body:
With his wife Taylor Swift watching closely, Travis Kelce raised concerns after suffering a right ankle injury during the Kansas City Chief s ’ opening drive against the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 6.

Travis Kelce raises concern with Taylor Swift watching from the suite

The Chiefs tight end caught a screen pass and, after gaining a few yards, went to the ground in pain following the tackle . The veteran player got back up with difficulty and quickly headed to the sideline to be evaluated by Kansas City’s medical staff.

Kelce received treatment during the Chiefs’ first possession and was forced to briefly leave the field. Cameras showed him removing his shoe while trainers worked on the affected area and applied a wrap to his right ankle.

The injury forced Kelce to miss the final two plays of the drive. In his absence, Noah Gray caught a 16-yard pass on third down , but it was not enough to move the chains, forcing Kansas City to settle for a 44-yard field goal by Harrison Butker .

According to Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star , Kelce appeared extremely frustrated on the sideline immediately after the injury . The report also noted that the team did not use the blue medical evaluation tent, while Sam McDowell reported that the veteran tight end wa s “feeling it” after the play.

Near the end of the first quarter, CBS sideline reporter Melanie Collins reported that Kelce’s ankle tape was reinforced after he returned to the field for Kansas City’s second offensive possession.

Although the situation sparked concern among Chiefs fans, Kelce returned to the field and, for now, remains involved in the game as the team continues to monitor his condition.

The Chiefs tight end caught a screen pass and, after gaining a few yards, went to the ground in pain following the tackle . The veteran player got back up with difficulty and quickly headed to the sideline to be evaluated by Kansas City’s medical staff.

Kelce received treatment during the Chiefs’ first possession and was forced to briefly leave the field. Cameras showed him removing his shoe while trainers worked on the affected area and applied a wrap to his right ankle.

The injury forced Kelce to miss the final two plays of the drive. In his absence, Noah Gray caught a 16-yard pass on third down , but it was not enough to move the chains, forcing Kansas City to settle for a 44-yard field goal by Harrison Butker .

The report also noted that the team did not use the blue medical evaluation tent, while Sam McDowell reported that the veteran tight end wa s “feeling it” after the play.
Near the end of the first quarter, CBS sideline reporter Melanie Collins reported that Kelce’s ankle tape was reinforced after he returned to the field for Kansas City’s second offensive possession.

articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift watched as Travis Kelce suffered an early injury scare, but the Chiefs star refused to stay down.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift watched as Travis Kelce suffered an early injury scare, but the Chiefs star refused to stay down.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs returned from their bye week with a dominant performance, defeating the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6 to improve to a perfect 6-0.

The victory began with a moment of concern for Chiefs Kingdom. Tight end Travis Kelce briefly left the field with a right ankle issue during the team’s first offensive series.

After catching a screen pass and gaining a few yards, Kelce went down following a tackle by Chargers linebacker Daiyan Henley . The veteran showed pain as he got up and headed to the sideline, where Kansas City’s medical staff examined the area and applied a wrap to his ankle.

The concern extended to Taylor Swift , who was watching from a suite at Arrowhead Stadium after traveling from Los Angeles, where she had attended the Academy Museum Gala the night before. Fortunately for Kansas City, Kelce was able to return to the game and finished with four receptions on five targets for 53 yards.

Andy Reid reassures fans after Travis Kelce’s injury

After the game, Chiefs head coach Andy Reid addressed the status of his top tight end and indicated that while Kelce will be sore, the injury does not appear serious.

“Travis Kelce tweaked his ankle and played through it. Says he’ll be sore tomorrow, but he’ll be OK,” Reid said.

At 37 years old, Kelce continues to show that experience still matters. Through six games this season , he has 16 receptions for 246 yards and two touchdowns, remaining a key piece of the offense led by Patrick Mahomes.

After the win, Kelce entered the locker room without any obvious limp and with a wide smile — an image that brought relief to Kansas City fans.

In the rest of the injury report, Reid confirmed that offensive tackle Jaylon Moore suffered a concussion. Wide receive r Jalen Royals was also evaluated for a possible head injury but was cleared to return to the game. Kingsley Suamataia finished the contest fine after taking a shot to the calf.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes fires a warning at Tom Brady after another historic NFL milestone
articles.standfirst: After tying Tom Brady’s record, Patrick Mahomes sent a clear message: his chase for greatness is far from over.
articles.summary: After tying Tom Brady’s record, Patrick Mahomes sent a clear message: his chase for greatness is far from over.
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes continues to close in on Tom Brady’s legend. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback once again entered the NFL record books by matching one of the former Patriots star’s most impressive milestones.

With a 22-6 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers at Arrowhead Stadium , Mahomes reached 100 regular-season wins , becoming, alongside Brady the quarterback who reached that mark the fastest in league history.

The three-time Super Bowl champion achieved the historic milestone in just 131 career start s, a pace that once again places him in the same conversation as one of the most dominant players of all time.

After the game, Mahomes spoke with CBS Sports reporter Melanie Collins and made it clear he has no plans to slow down.

“It seems like every time I win a game, I’m tying him [Tom Brady], so I’m gonna keep winning,” he said postgame.

Mahomes keeps climbing among the NFL’s greats

The win over the Chargers allowed the Chiefs to remain perfect at 5-0 , while Los Angeles dropped to 0-6 .

At just 31 years old, Mahomes continues to pile up achievements that bring him closer to the most important names in NFL history. His statistical rivalry with Brady has become one of the league’s most frequent comparisons.

Brady himself has repeatedly acknowledged Mahomes’ level and called him the best quarterback in the NFL today.

“Pat’s the best quarterback in the NFL, he’s unbelievable,” Brady said last year. “It doesn’t take away from his greatness at all. He’s just playing within the rules and how they’re calling them.”

The seven-time Super Bowl champion also offered advice to Mahomes during an injury recovery process , stressing the importance of maintaining an elite athlete’s mindset.

“The only thing you can do is focus on what’s ahead of you and not look back,” Brady said. “And just say, OK, this is part of what my career is going to be. And a lot of people have gone through it and a lot of people have overcome it. You’ve just got to put as much diligence into the rehab process. And I always feel like the faster you rehab, the faster you can get back to practicing the sport that you know you love. I think sometimes people will pace themselves. Instead of training mode, they’re in rehab mode. I think you gotta get through rehab mode as fast as possible and then you get back to training mode. But that requires an all-out commitment and it’s the same commitment that the great professional athletes make to be great at their profession. When you go through the rehab process, you need that same level of focus and determination.”

articles.title: Donna Kelce tries to save Travis Kelce from a shady situation that could upset Taylor Swift
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs star’s social media history is being probed once again
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs star’s social media history is being probed once again
articles.body:
D onna Kelce has publicly rejected claims linking her son Travis Kelce to a series of resurfaced social media posts containing derogatory comments about women as the allegations have drawn renewed attention to the Kansas City Chiefs tight end. His online history is under scrutiny once again, prompting his mother to challenge the account's authenticity as the posts reportedly appeared between 2009 and 2011 on an X.com (formerly Twitter) account identified as “@tkelce.”

From before Travis entered the NFL , Donna was tagged in some of the deleted messages, which criticized women's appearances and body types in language that has since attracted scrutiny. One alleged tweet stated, “As a man, You have something wrong with you if your going for girls that weigh more then you.” Another reportedly asked, “Why can’t girls hide they backfat? That s**t nasty.” A third described judging strangers based on whether they were considered “ugly” or attractive, “Haha I just caught myself judging every person that walked past me, whether they were ugly, fat, funny looking, sexy haha I’m trippin.” Now his 74-year-old mother responded emphatically, distancing both herself and her son from the account as Donna said, “Not Travis’ handle and not his account!!”.

Travis Kelce previously addressed his old tweets

The controversy recalls Travis ' own comments about his social media history from his college days during an episode of his New Heights podcast, which he hosts with his brother Jason . The 37-year-old three-time Super Bowl champion acknowledged trying to remove older posts, even though he felt some offered a less serious picture of his younger self. “Sure enough, it came surface level and everybody f**king dove into 2011, what a f**king year that was,” Travis said. “What was I even f**king doing in some of these tweets?” On the field, the Chiefs strengthened their unbeaten start with a commanding 22-6 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday, improving to 5-0 while leaving their division rivals still searching for their first win. Running back Kenneth Walker led the way with 128 rushing yards and two touchdowns, including a 33-yard score that extended Kansas City 's early advantage whilst Xavier Worthy contributed seven receptions for 73 yards. Kelce added five catches for 53 yards despite briefly leaving the game with an ankle injury as the Chargers struggled offensively throughout the contest against a stern Chiefs defense. Justin Herbert threw for 204 yards and an interception, while Los Angeles managed only 259 total yards and allowed multiple sacks as the Chargers briefly threatened to rally in the second half but settled for a field goal after failing to convert inside the 15-yard line. Kansas City also overcame its own mistakes, including missed kicks by Harrison Butker and difficulties in short-yardage situations to maintain their perfect record ahead of a Week 7 game with the Seattle Seahawks .

articles.title: Chris Jones explodes at the Chiefs coach: tense shouting match in the middle of the game against the Chargers
articles.standfirst: Kansas City's defensive tackle was caught pushing Joe Cullen's hand away before engaging in a heated argument on the bench. The reason for the confrontation has not yet been revealed.
articles.summary: Kansas City's defensive tackle was caught pushing Joe Cullen's hand away before engaging in a heated argument on the bench. The reason for the confrontation has not yet been revealed.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs maintained their perfect start to the season with a commanding victory over the Los Angeles Chargers, but without a doubt one of the most striking scenes of the night happened far from the action.

Chris Jones was involved in a tense exchange with defensive line coach Joe Cullen during the second quarter of the game. Cameras caught the moment, and the argument quickly went viral.

What happened between Chris Jones and Joe Cullen?

The scene occurred when Kansas City was leading 9-3. Jones was sitting on the bench when Cullen approached to speak with him and placed a hand on his shoulder. The defender reacted by brushing it away, and the two began to argue heatedly. CBS reporter Melanie Collins later described the episode as a " screaming match" ("pelea a gritos").

The broadcast did not reveal what Jones and Cullen said to each other or what exactly caused the argument.

Collins noted that frustrations were growing within Kansas City's defense , but did not link the confrontation to a specific cause.

Former Chiefs quarterback and current CBS analyst Trent Green offered his own interpretation. According to Green, Jones and Cullen have a good relationship and the player may have reacted to the coach's contact when he placed his hand on his shoulder. That explanation, however, was not confirmed by Jones, Cullen, or the Chiefs.

The moment also came after a quiet start to the season for Jones in terms of production. The seven-time Pro Bowler had entered the game without recording any sacks in his first four outings. Against the Chargers, he finally got his first sack of the season, although it was shared with rookie Peter Woods.

And the defense ended up responding. Kansas City recorded four sacks on Justin Herbert and held the Chargers to just six points all night.

The Chiefs responded on the field

The argument did not prevent Kansas City from controlling the game. The Chiefs defeated the Chargers 22-6 at Arrowhead Stadium and improved their record to 5-0, while Los Angeles fell to 0-6.

Steve Spagnuolo's defense had one of its best performances of the season. Herbert found few options for much of the game and Kansas City managed to hold on to the lead until the end.

For Jones , moreover, the night ended with a small personal vindication. After four games without sacks, he showed up on the defensive stat sheet again with a shared sack with Woods . The incident with Cullen, which took place a few hours earlier, thus remained one of the most striking images of a day that ended with a victory for the Chiefs.

articles.title: Taylor Swift visibly annoyed as Chiefs fan crosses the line during game
articles.standfirst: A fan’s attempt to get a closer video of the singer at Arrowhead Stadium appeared to push her patience to the limit
articles.summary: A fan’s attempt to get a closer video of the singer at Arrowhead Stadium appeared to push her patience to the limit
articles.body:
T aylor Swift has reportedly felt anxious about attending Travis Kelce’s games , and an incident at Arrowhead Stadium shows why those concerns may exist. For the singer, one of the most important things about watching the Kansas City Chiefs is allowing the attention to stay on the players rather than on her.

Wherever Swift goes, she is bound to attract attention, photographs and curious looks. However, some fans struggle to recognize when they are crossing a line, making it difficult for celebrities to enjoy a game without feeling watched.

When a fan gets too close

Swift was in the Chiefs’ suite on Sunday, watching Kansas City take on the Chargers. She was there with friends and family, cheering on Kelce and joining in the excitement of the game. However, a video from the event appears to show her becoming annoyed when a fan nearby tried to film her from close range.

The footage suggests that someone believed to be part of Swift’s security team asked the fan to stop taking pictures . The fan appeared to ignore the request and continued using her phone to get a closer shot of the singer, prompting a visible reaction from Swift.

Swift makes her frustration clear

Swift appeared to gesture toward the fan, seemingly signaling that the game was happening on the field and that the players, not her, should be the focus . Her facial expressions also suggested that she was uncomfortable with the situation as the fan continued trying to record her.

The clip prompted discussion online about giving Swift enough space to enjoy the game. While fans may be excited to see the singer in person and naturally want a photo, many pointed out that discretion matters, especially when someone has already been asked to stop recording . The moment served as a reminder that even at a high-profile game, celebrities should be able to enjoy the action without having their personal space invaded.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes now has a new Chiefs teammate and looks to be putting Tyreek Hill and their issues behind him
articles.standfirst: Kenneth Walker III starred against the Chargers while injury concerns and legal uncertainty complicate Hill's potential NFL comeback
articles.summary: Kenneth Walker III starred against the Chargers while injury concerns and legal uncertainty complicate Hill's potential NFL comeback
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs have spent much of the early season dealing with injuries at wide receiver, but Patrick Mahomes is discovering that his offense has another way to win without relying entirely on its passing game.

Kenneth Walker III continued his outstanding start to the campaign on Sunday, scoring twice as Kansas City defeated the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6 to preserve its unbeaten record.

The running back rushed for 128 yards on 19 carries, providing the decisive moments in a game where Mahomes struggled to turn promising drives into touchdowns.

His emergence has given Kansas City additional flexibility at a time when speculation continues over whether former Chiefs receiver Tyreek Hill could return to the franchise.

Kansas City's offense was far from flawless against Los Angeles, committing two costly mistakes near the goal line despite controlling much of the contest.

Mahomes completed 76 percent of his passes for 272 yards but threw an interception in the end zone and finished without a passing touchdown. Walker , however, delivered when the Chiefs needed him most.

Late in the second quarter, the running back appeared trapped behind the line of scrimmage before changing direction and escaping toward the outside.

Mahomes helped create the opening by blocking Chargers edge rusher Tuli Tuipulotu , allowing Walker to finish the two-yard touchdown run.

"With Kenneth, you got to be ready," Mahomes explained afterward.

"The defense that they [the Chargers] had, the moment he got stuffed on that front side, I was like, if I get him [Tuipulotu] he's [Walker] going to score. I didn't get a lot, but I got enough."

Walker now leads NFL running backs with 665 rushing yards, establishing himself as a major contributor to Kansas City's early success.

Tyreek Hill reunion remains uncertain

With Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton unavailable, the Chiefs have reasons to consider strengthening their receiving group. However, a reunion with Hill does not appear imminent.

According to The Athletic's Jonathan Jones, Kansas City isn't rushing to sign the veteran receiver and continues to explore alternatives.

Hill has been recovering from a serious knee injury suffered during the 2025 season, which limited him to just four appearances with the Miami Dolphins .

Former NFL cornerback Richard Sherman believes Hill's eventual asking price could also influence his options.

"If he's asking for $20 million a year or $10 million with a ton of incentives, I think that puts out a lot of the top contenders," Sherman said on The Richard Sherman Show.

Those figures were hypothetical, with Hill's actual salary expectations remaining unclear.

Legal questions complicate Tyreek Hill comeback

Hill 's situation has become more complicated following a civil case involving his estranged wife, Keeta Vaccaro .

A jury found the receiver liable on two battery claims and awarded Vaccaro $500,000 in compensatory damages.

NFL insider Jordan Schultz has suggested that potential disciplinary action could influence when Hill signs with another team, although the league has not announced a suspension.

"There's still a possibility in my mind he signs in a few weeks, in a month," Schultz said on the Ross Tucker Podcast.

Meanwhile, Walker 's production is helping Kansas City maintain its momentum despite significant personnel challenges.

The Chiefs haven't ruled out adding another receiver, but their victory over Los Angeles demonstrated that Mahomes already has a dependable offensive partner capable of deciding games.

articles.title: The WNBA takes a break from the Finals and gives strange reaction to seeing Caitlin Clark alongside Taylor Swift with the Chiefs
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs had plenty to celebrate after another convincing victory on Sunday, but one of the afternoon's biggest talking points developed away from the field when Caitlin Clark reunited with Taylor Swift at Arrowhead Stadium.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs had plenty to celebrate after another convincing victory on Sunday, but one of the afternoon's biggest talking points developed away from the field when Caitlin Clark reunited with Taylor Swift at Arrowhead Stadium.

The Indiana Fever guard joined the pop superstar in her private suite as Kansas City defeated the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6, extending its unbeaten start to five games.

Clark , a lifelong Chiefs supporter, attended alongside boyfriend Connor McCaffery and received a warm welcome from Swift , who greeted her with a hug.

Their reunion quickly attracted attention online, including an unexpected acknowledgment from the WNBA's official social media account.

With the WNBA Finals between the Atlanta Dream and Golden State Valkyries underway, the league briefly turned its attention toward Clark 's appearance at the NFL game.

After Complex shared footage of the basketball star arriving at Arrowhead Stadium, the WNBA responded with a short message. "Hey Caitlin," the league wrote on X.

Although the greeting appeared lighthearted, it drew criticism from some social media users who questioned the decision to highlight Clark while the championship series was taking place.

The reaction reflected an ongoing debate surrounding the league's biggest personalities and how their popularity can influence attention across women's basketball.

There was no indication that the message was intended to diminish the Finals, but its timing became part of the discussion surrounding Clark 's latest public appearance.

Clark joins Swift for another Chiefs victory

Clark 's relationship with Swift has developed through their shared enthusiasm for Kansas City, with the pair previously watching the Chiefs together during the 2025 playoffs.

Their connection followed Clark 's attendance at Swift's Eras Tour in Indianapolis in 2024, before the singer invited her to an AFC Divisional Round matchup against the Houston Texans .

Speaking to David Eickholt of 247Sports in January 2025, Clark explained how their mutual support for the Chiefs had strengthened their friendship.

"It's just cute to see how excited she is for the Chiefs," Clark said. "And getting to share that with her, I'm like, 'Oh my God, I love this!' She loves the Chiefs as much as me."

The two also attended a game against the Detroit Lions together in October 2025, making Sunday's reunion another chapter in their increasingly familiar Arrowhead appearances.

Clark's Nike promotion adds to Chiefs appearance

Clark 's visit also involved a professional commitment, with Nike promoting her Caitlin 1 signature basketball shoe at the New Heights Tailgate before kickoff.

The event was connected to the popular podcast hosted by Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce and his brother, former Philadelphia Eagles center Jason Kelce .

Fans attending the pregame gathering could view the shoe display, while Jason participated in a scheduled meet-and-greet.

On the field, running back Kenneth Walker III scored twice as Kansas City secured another victory, despite a brief injury concern involving Kelce, who subsequently returned.

Clark 's appearance once again demonstrated her appeal beyond basketball, particularly when sharing the spotlight with one of the world's biggest entertainers.

Meanwhile, the WNBA's brief acknowledgment showed how even a casual social media interaction involving its most recognizable players can become a talking point during the league's biggest events.
