articles.standfirst: One lucky fan got a moment with both Kansas City stars that everyone else would love to have
articles.summary: One lucky fan got a moment with both Kansas City stars that everyone else would love to have
articles.body:
T he Kansas City Chiefs are on a winning streak, and fans are feeling the momentum. With the team continuing to deliver results and Patrick Mahomes looking stronger, the players have become bigger idols than ever for a fanbase that does not want this run to stop.

After a win over the Los Angeles Rams that took Kansas City to 5-0, the Chiefs had even more reason to celebrate. Mahomes also reached 100 regular-season wins in his 131st start, tying Tom Brady's record. With those milestones , the team was bound to receive plenty of attention from fans as the players made their way off the field.

One fan got a moment to remember

Travis Kelce also appeared to be in good spirits, despite seemingly tweaking his ankle on the opening drive against Los Angeles. The moment gave fans a scare, but o nce the players left the field and entered the tunnel, both were welcomed like heroes.

With the area packed with people hoping to catch a glimpse of the stars, one moment stood out. Mahomes and Kelce both approached the same woman to greet and hug her, giving her a moment few Chiefs fans could dream of experiencing.

A hug from both Chiefs stars

The woman was facing away from the camera, so her identity remains unknown . Still, she was undoubtedly the envy of the crowd, as both players took the time to stop and embrace her while making their way through the tunnel.

She might just be the team's lucky charm , although there is no way to know for sure. What Chiefs fans do know is that they want the wins to keep coming, especially after the team failed to reach the playoffs last season. It was a major disappointment for a fanbase accustomed to seeing Mahomes and Kelce deliver big results, and their current run has given supporters plenty of reasons to believe again.

articles.title: Ex-Chiefs star drops brutal truth about Travis Kelce injury
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce battled through an ankle injury, and his former Chiefs teammate had a powerful message about his toughness.
articles.summary: Travis Kelce battled through an ankle injury, and his former Chiefs teammate had a powerful message about his toughness.
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce received strong praise from his former teammate Gehrig Dieter after showing his toughness by playing through an ankle injury during the Kansas City Chiefs ’ 22-6 win over the Los Angeles Chargers .

Kelce raised concerns in the opening minutes of the October 18 matchup at Arrowhead Stadium after being tackled by Chargers linebacker Daiyan Henley. The tight end’s leg appeared to get trapped underneath the defender, forcing the veteran player to briefly leave the field while walking with noticeable discomfort.

The 37-year-old tight end was evaluated by Kansas City’s medical staff , who wrapped his ankle before he returned to the field to continue playing.

Despite the scare , Kelce finished the game with four receptions for 53 yards , helping the Chiefs maintain thei r perfect record at 5-0 on the season.

Former teammate praises Travis Kelce’s toughness

Dieter , a former Chiefs wide receiver who played alongside Kelce during Kansas City’s Super Bowl LIV championship run, highlighted the veteran tight end’s commitment and competitive mindset.

“Kelce is a dawg! They don’t make ’em like him anymore,” Dieter wrote on X. “Anyone else would be milking that ankle injury.”

Dieter was with the Chiefs from 2017 to 2021 and was part of the roster that won Super Bowl LIV.

His comments came as Kelce continues his 14th NFL season, establishing himself as one of the most dominant tight ends in league history.

Before facing Los Angeles , Kelce had recorded 246 receiving yards and two touchdowns through Kansas City’s first four games.

He also entered the matchup ranked as the second-best tight end in the NFL according to Pro Football Network’s TE Impact Score , with a rating of 86.6.

articles.title: Kenneth Walker puts Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs in uncharted territory during their dynasty era
articles.standfirst: Despite having played one fewer game, Walker III still leads the NFL in rushing yards with 665
articles.summary: Despite having played one fewer game, Walker III still leads the NFL in rushing yards with 665
articles.body:
With a win tonight against the Washington Commanders , the San Francisco 49ers will remain one of the three unbeaten teams in the NFL alongside the Minnesota Vikings , who rested on their bye week, and the Kansas City Chiefs , who have put the whole league on notice that they are back and ready to compete against any team to go back to their Super Bowl days.

The Chiefs easily defeated the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6 on Sunday, with Kenneth Walker III shining once again as he rushed for 128 yards and two touchdowns. That explosive effort allowed Walker to join Calvin Johnson (2011) as the only two players with 2+ touchdowns in four of their team's first five games of a season since the AFL-NFL merger.

Up next for Kansas City is a matchup against Walker's former team, the Seattle Seahawks , who extended their franchise record during a Thursday loss to Denver to 35 straight games without allowing a 100-yard rusher , and now face their former star and reigning Super Bowl MVP.

Kenneth Walker III Unlocks Uncharted Offense for Patrick Mahomes

With his dominant performance on Sunday, Walker now boasts a league-leading 665 rushing yards despite playing one fewer game than Bijan Robinson (641) and James Cook (627) , who round out this year's top three ground gainers after six weeks.

Walker has also accumulated eight total touchdowns on the campaign, helping Patrick Mahomes feel significantly less pressure under center while providing Kansas City with a high-volume ground game he has never experienced in his decorated career.

In fact, Walker's 665 rushing yards through five appearances already surpass Kareem Hunt's 611 rushing yards across the entire 2025 season, making him the most prolific backfield partner Mahomes has ever lined up beside.

Across his first five games with the franchise, Walker became just the sixth player in NFL history to log at least 750 scrimmage yards and eight touchdowns in that opening stretch, a pristine club that includes Pro Football Hall of Famers Jim Brown , Eric Dickerson , Marshall Faulk , Emmitt Smith , and former Chiefs icon Priest Holmes .

Kansas City's upcoming clash against Seattle next Sunday promises plenty of drama as Walker returns to confront his former club, showcasing their mistake in letting him go while leading the entire league in rushing yards.

articles.title: Taylor Swift 'steers' Brittany Mahomes away from the Chiefs' spotlight
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes' wife is now 'invisible' during television broadcasts of the Kansas City team's games
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes' wife is now 'invisible' during television broadcasts of the Kansas City team's games
articles.body:
The friendship between Taylor Swift and Brittany Mahomes has remained strong over time; however, the singer’s entry into the lives of Travis Kelce and the Chiefs has, in effect, pushed her friend and Patrick Mahomes ’ wife further into the background.

Before Taylor arrived on the scene, Brittany was arguably the most well-known NFL WAG , with cameras frequently seeking her out in the stadium whenever her husband pulled off a standout play. When Swift and Kelce began their relationship, Brittany’s routine didn’t change much, as the two women would often watch the Kansas City games together from the same suite. Their celebrations—hugging or sharing a joke—would go viral whenever the cameras caught them following a major scoring play. Yet, as Taylor and Travis’s romance grew more serious, the pop star moved to the Kelce family suite, effectively causing Brittany to disappear from the game-day spotlight.

During the recent game against the Chargers , cameras repeatedly focused on Taylor whenever Travis gained yardage—just as they had in previous games, even when he scored a touchdown. It’s something she doesn’t particularly enjoy, but has had to accept given her global fame. Meanwhile, television broadcasts have chosen to ignore Mahomes’ wife, who continues to attend every one of her husband’s games, whether at Arrowhead or on the road. She never misses one.

Caitlin Clark was a guest of Travis Kelce

Taylor enjoyed the Chiefs’ latest victory alongside Caitlin Clark and the Kelce parents. Brittany was in a separate suite with her children and the rest of the Mahomes family. As always, she made an appearance on the field to share a kiss with Patrick—a gesture that has effectively become a ritual.

Afterward, Brittany always makes sure her presence is known—just in case there was any doubt—by sharing updates on her social media. She frequently shows off her chosen outfit for the occasion and celebrates the Chiefs’ wins. Unlike Taylor, she keeps her followers updated on her personal life, which has led to partnerships with various sponsors and high-profile campaigns—such as her appearance in a swimsuit for Sports Illustrated Swimsuit .

So, Taylor Swift has kept her out of the spotlight during the games, but Brittany has managed perfectly well to maintain her own profile—making it clear that she is always there wherever Patrick is playing.

articles.title: Chiefs could take advantage of AFC team in shambles to secure a wide receiver for Patrick Mahomes
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs still need wide receiver help, even when Rashee Rice comes back from injury.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs still need wide receiver help, even when Rashee Rice comes back from injury.
articles.body:
Not even the Kansas City Chiefs could have imagined such a smooth start to their 2026 season. A year after going 6-11 in disappointing fashion, and with Patrick Mahomes coming off of a major knee injury, the Chiefs have begun this season with a 5-0 record.

Three of their wins have been blowouts, including their most recent victory over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 6. Kansas City lead the league in offensive yards per game, are fifth in points per game, and second in points per game allowed. Yet despite their success, there's still something that doesn't feel totally right.

In particular, Mahomes hasn't been able to get the passing attack flying just yet. His last two games have revealed some flaws in the passing game. To be fair, Mahomes hasn't had to put on the Superman cape, since running back Kenneth Walker III is playing like an MVP candidate. But Chiefs fans believe Mahomes needs more help at wide receiver .

Could Chiefs explore trade for Josh Downs?

Rashee Rice is set to come back from injury sooner than later, but even he didn't look quite right following offseason knee surgery . With Tyquan Thornton done for the season, the front office could look for an explosive pass-catching option, and the Indianapolis Colts present the perfect buying opportunity, with Josh Downs as a potential target.

The Colts just fell to 2-4 after a brutal home loss to the previously winless Tennessee Titans . In the aftermath, general manager Chris Ballard was fired. Ballard drafted Downs in the third round in 2023, and he hasn't quite lived up to the hype in his fourth season despite showing glimpses of greatness .

With Michael Pittman Jr. traded away in the offseason, Downs was expected to become the team's top target-earner, but he simply hasn't been efficient or productive. If the Colts decide to tank for the rest of the season, Downs could be on the trade block, since his rookie contract runs out at the end of this season .

Xavier Worthy has been a solid pass-catcher for Mahomes, but he's more of a vertical threat. Downs does most of his work in the short and intermediate areas of the field, which Mahomes likes feeding whether Rice is on the field as well or not.

articles.standfirst: Jackson Mahomes tells Patrick “don’t be mad” after mom Randi names him her favorite son
articles.summary: Jackson Mahomes tells Patrick “don’t be mad” after mom Randi names him her favorite son
articles.body:
Randi Mahomes has seemingly picked a side in a playful family debate, naming Jackson her “favorite son” and giving Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes an opening to be teased.

The exchange appeared on Instagram after Kansas City’s 22-6 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on October 18, when the Chiefs improved to 5-0.

Jackson, Patrick’s younger brother, posted a photo of himself on the sidelines at Arrowhead Stadium, wearing a green hoodie from one of his brand partners.

The post might have passed without much fuss, but Randi joined the comments with a short message that quickly became the highlight.

“Favorite son,” she wrote.

Jackson was ready with a cheeky reply: “I already know; don’t be mad @patrickmahomes.” By tagging Patrick, Jackson no doubt meant to turn their mother’s comment into a little sibling rivalry.

Patrick and Jackson Mahomes have a long history of sibling teasing

The brothers grew up in Tyler, Texas, with their mother, Randi , and father, Pat Mahomes , a former Major League Baseball pitcher who played for several teams.

Their careers took different directions: Patrick became one of the NFL’s leading quarterbacks, while Jackson built a following as a social media personality, posting lifestyle content and sharing moments from his visits to Chiefs games.

He’s also acknowledged that being Patrick’s brother brings opportunities, though their relationship extends beyond the attention.

Jackson spoke warmly about their bond in his first YouTube video, released in May 2020. He described Patrick as a cool person and said they were very close. That closeness has also been visible during important moments in Patrick’s life: Jackson was his best man when Patrick married Brittany Mahomes in March 2022.

Meanwhile, Patrick’s family life continues to produce memorable moments.

His three-year-old son, Bronze , recently joined him after a postgame press conference and cheerfully told reporters, “Bye-bye,” prompting laughter as they left the room.

Patrick has also revealed that Bronze enjoys playing tackle football at home, meaning the quarterback’s breaks from the NFL aren’t always restful.

“The only thing that’s changed is chasing kids around more,” Mahomes said.

“As they get older, it’s not as much laying around and not doing anything. You’re home now. You’re dad. So you have to be around. You have to chase kids around. Bronze loves to play tackle now.”

Brittany recently called her husband “Dad of the year” after sharing footage of him helping Bronze practice baseball in heavy rain.

Randi’s latest comment might have temporarily crowned Jackson the favorite, but Patrick has plenty to celebrate beyond football.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes won’t stay quiet about Patrick Mahomes and what he’s doing with the Chiefs in the NFL
articles.standfirst: She knows her words matter to Patrick
articles.summary: She knows her words matter to Patrick
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes posted a simple message after Kansas City’s latest win. Brittany answered with an emphatic show of support as her husband and the Chiefs keep turning their season around.

“ 5-0,” Patrick wrote on Instagram after the Chiefs beat the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6. Brittany responded in the comments: “FIVE & ZEROOOOOO.” Her all-caps celebration matched the moment: Kansas City is unbeaten through five games, and Patrick is back in the middle of another strong run.

Mahomes has thrown for 1,309 yards and nine touchdowns in five games, completing 105 of 158 passes. He has three interceptions and six sacks. Against the Chargers, he went 23-for-30 for 272 yards and reached a career milestone: his 100th regular-season win as a starting quarterback, matching Tom Brady’s record for the fewest starts needed to get there.

Brittany’s message celebrates a Chiefs team that’s finding its rhythm

Kansas City’s 5-0 start carries extra weight after a 2025 season that ended with the Chiefs missing the playoffs and Mahomes sidelined by a knee injury. This time, the quarterback has returned to lead an offense that is producing, while the defense is making its mark, too.

Against Los Angeles, running back Kenneth Walker III rushed for 128 yards and two touchdowns, and the Chiefs defense recorded four sacks.

Brittany’s support comes from someone with a sporting career of her own. She played college soccer and spent a year playing professionally in Iceland; she is also a founder of the Kansas City Current, the city’s NWSL team. Her brief comment celebrated Patrick’s post, but it also reflected the excitement around the start he and the Chiefs have put together.

The Mahomes family has three children: Sterling, Bronze and Golden. Patrick recently joked that his kids kept him busy during the Chiefs’ bye week, adding that Bronze, 3 , already loves playing tackle football at home. He has also said he wants his children to choose their own interests without feeling pressure to follow in his footsteps.

The Chiefs will try to make it six straight wins when they visit the Seattle Seahawks on Sunday, Oct. 25. Kickoff is scheduled for 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC.

articles.title: Chiefs set to miss out on Tyreek Hill as NFC contender makes aggressive move
articles.standfirst: Tyreek Hill's expected NFL return may not include a reunion with the Chiefs, as another contender has emerged as the favorite to land the star wide receiver.
articles.summary: Tyreek Hill's expected NFL return may not include a reunion with the Chiefs, as another contender has emerged as the favorite to land the star wide receiver.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs appeared to be the ideal destination fo r Tyreek Hill ’s return, especially after the wave of injuries that has impacted the team. However, another NFL contender could move ahead of them and land the explosive receiver.

Hill is getting closer to returning to the field after suffering a serious knee injury last season, and his agent said the wide receiver is nearing a comeback. Although Kansas City could still attempt to reunite with one of the most important players in recent franchise history, Alex Kay of Bleacher Report believes another team with a more urgent need could take the lead.

Tyreek Hill could change course

Kay projected that Hill could end up with th e Los Angeles Rams , a team that entered the season as a Super Bowl favorite before falling to 2-3 after an unexpected loss to th e Arizona Cardinals .

Los Angeles’ urgency increased after losing Davante Adams , who suffered a hamstring tear that could keep him sidelined for the remainder of the regular season.

“With Adams expected to miss six to 10 weeks while he recovers from a ruptured hamstring, the Rams need to offset the loss of their star wideout with a pickup on the open market, ” Kay wrote. “No free agent can move the needle more than Tyreek Hill.”

Adams had a spectacular start to the season, recording 30 receptions for 480 yards and four touchdowns in six games. If Hill can regain part of his best physical form — something his agent Drew Rosenhaus believes is close — he could become a premium replacement option.

“Hill’s résumé makes him an attractive potential replacement, although his recovery and lengthy absence create questions about how quickly he could contribute. If healthy, his speed, route-running ability and elusiveness could help Los Angeles replace some of Adams’ production,” Kay added.

Chiefs could target another star receiver

Although Kansas City needs reinforcements at wide receiver after Tyquan Thornton’s ankle dislocation, some analysts believe the team could pursue a younger and more explosive option than Hill.

ESPN analyst Benjamin Solak suggested that the Chiefs could make a move for Dallas Cowboys wide receive r George Pickens .

Solak believes Pickens could be nearing the end of his time in Dallas once the season concludes , and that the Cowboys could take advantage of his current value to negotiate a trade.

articles.title: Randi Mahomes draws on Patrick Mahomes’ Chiefs journey to guide families on college recruiting and NIL
articles.standfirst: The mother of the Chiefs quarterback is bringing her Sports Parent Academy to Miami
articles.summary: The mother of the Chiefs quarterback is bringing her Sports Parent Academy to Miami
articles.body:
R andi Mahomes is used to cheering for her son from the sidelines. Now she wants to share what she has learned while supporting Patrick Mahomes , from his early years in sports to his rise in the NFL . Her next step is the Ultimate Sports Parent Experience , a family event scheduled for Saturday, Oct. 24, in Miami.

The event is not a recruiting fair, and it is not limited to one sport or to athletes already in college. It is designed for families navigating youth sports, with conversations on performance, college recruiting, name, image and likeness (NIL), and family dynamics. The program also includes panels with athletes, sports experts and parents.

Randi Mahomes turns her experience into support for other families

Before launching the academy, Randi had years of experience organizing events. She has worked as an event planner at Hollytree Country Club since 2005. In 2025, she launched Sports Parent Academy, an online program for parents supporting their children through different stages of sports. “I’m also, just like many of you, a parent trying to navigate the ups and downs of raising an athlete,” she said when introducing it.

Patrick’s path gives her a personal perspective: he played college football at Texas Tech before becoming an NFL star. But Randi presents the academy as a resource for families at different points in a young athlete’s development, not as a formula for reaching the pros. She hosted an in-person event in Lubbock in July; the Miami gathering is the project’s next stop.

College recruiting and NIL can sound like issues reserved for elite athletes, but they can shape the choices families face as a young player considers college sports.

NIL stands for “name, image and likeness.” It refers to deals through which athletes can receive money, products or services in exchange for the use of their identity, such as in a social media post, endorsement or appearance.

The Miami event runs from 2 to 6 p.m. at Fontainebleau Miami Beach , with a conversation featuring Randi scheduled to begin at 3:30 p.m. In her invitation, she said she was excited to spend the afternoon with families who know how much commitment it takes to show up for their children in sports.

This is not Randi’s first move into youth sports: Sports Parent Academy has been underway since 2025. The Miami event is a new opportunity to bring the project to families in person and turn a story many people know through Patrick Mahomes into a conversation for parents starting their own sports journey.

articles.title: The fan who harassed Taylor Swift at Arrowhead made a mistake that could have led to his ejection, according to a witness
articles.standfirst: The incident occurred as the Kansas City Chiefs took on the Los Angeles Chargers
articles.summary: The incident occurred as the Kansas City Chiefs took on the Los Angeles Chargers
articles.body:
A fan who approached Taylor Swift ’s VIP suite during the Kansas City Chiefs ’ game against the Los Angeles Chargers risked being removed from Arrowhead Stadium after allegedly entering another spectator’s row and ignoring security. The claims come according to eyewitness Ashlie Molstad , who said the woman had crossed four people to reach her row before shouting the Grammy -winning singer’s name in Week 6 of the NFL season.

Although she could not see the singer directly, she watched the security guard intervene and tell the woman, “These are not your seats. You need to leave.” According to Molstad , the woman explained that she had traveled from Germany and was wearing Oktoberfest clothing, but the explanation apparently did not change the guard’s response. The fan then tried to take a quick photograph before he raised his hand to block the camera as video from the suite area showed Swift gesturing toward the field and appearing to tell the person filming to watch the game instead. Molstad said she did not hear Swift speak, but believed the footage showed the singer saying something like, “I’m watching the game,” as she continues to support her husband, Travis Kelce. “The frustrating part was her assuming she had the right to rush into our row and get right in Taylor’s face, which was distracting while we were trying to watch the game,” Molstad said, describing crossing into another row and approaching Swift ’s suite made the encounter disruptive. She said Swift did not appear distressed from what she could see in the footage, and seemed focused on the Chiefs ’ game. Molstad praised the guard for keeping the exchange brief rather than escalating it into a larger scene. “He didn’t make a big scene,” Molstad said, claiming “he just put his hand up and said, ‘I don’t care. These are not your seats.'” The witness described another incident outside the suite, claiming she and a friend saw a man pressed against the window and flipping Swift off as they alerted police officers stationed nearby, who removed him from the area.

Chiefs shrug off Chargers to remain unbeaten

On the field, Kenneth Walker delivered 128 yards on the ground and two touchdowns, while Patrick Mahome s accumulated 272 passing yards as despite missing wide receivers Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton , Kansas City improved to 5-0. Keeping pace with the San Francisco 49ers and Minnesota Vikings as the NFL 's only undefeated teams, Xavier Worthy contributed seven receptions for 73 yards, and Kelce finished with five catches totaling 53 yards. The victory also gave Kansas City a different outcome against its AFC West rivals after the Chargers swept their two meetings last season as Walker provided the Chiefs ' biggest offensive moment, breaking free for a 33-yard touchdown. His production reinforced his standing as the league's leading rusher while the Chargers struggled to slow Kansas City 's running game whilst Los Angeles , meanwhile, continued to struggle offensively, finishing with 259 total yards. Justin Herbert threw for 204 yards but surrendered an interception, his eighth of the season, extending his league-leading total. The Chargers had an opportunity to make the contest closer after reaching the 15-yard line following halftime. However, Herbert 's consecutive incompletions ended the drive with another field goal rather than a touchdown whilst the Chiefs also had shortcomings, with Harrison Butker missing both an extra-point attempt and a field goal.

articles.title: Allen Bailey's Cause of Death: What caused the death of the former Kansas City Chiefs and Atlanta Falcons player at age 37?
articles.standfirst: Bailey was found dead on Tuesday, October 20
articles.summary: Bailey was found dead on Tuesday, October 20
articles.body:
Former NFL defensive end Allen Bailey has died at 37, with his family believing he passed away from natural causes after his wife discovered him inside their Florida home. The circumstances surrounding his death have been reported, but no specific medical cause has been confirmed in the supplied information.

Bailey 's brother, Alford Jr. , told TMZ that his wife found him dead the previous day, as the family believes the former Kansas City Chiefs and Atlanta Falcons player died naturally, although further details explaining what happened have not been provided.

The news prompted tributes from people connected to Bailey 's football career, including former teammate Colin McCarthy , who announced his death on October 20 and remembered him online.

“Lost a fellow brother today… prayers to AB family! Love you Big Cuzzo!” McCarthy wrote, expressing his grief and support for the family.

Away from the NFL , Bailey invested in the community where he grew up as he established the Allen Bailey Foundation in 2012 to support families in Georgia 's McIntosh , Glynn and Camden counties, with initiatives focused on children, education and local needs.

Among its programs was Southeast Skillz , which became McIntosh County 's first free football camp. The foundation also distributed backpacks to schoolchildren and supported student-athletes through initiatives including the Champions of Tomorrow Scholarship and Legacy Builders Fund .

Its annual Don't Be Jive Turkey Drive , launched in 2016, provided more than 300 turkeys to families ahead of Thanksgiving.

Those efforts helped Bailey maintain a connection to his hometown long after he left Georgia to pursue a career in professional football.

What was Allen Bailey's cause of death?

Bailey was born on March 25, 1989, on Sapelo Island , Georgia , and built his professional career after playing college football for the Miami Hurricanes . The Chiefs selected him 86th overall in the third round of the 2011 NFL Draft .

He spent eight seasons in Kansas City , becoming an important member of the defensive line. His best statistical season came in 2018, when he recorded 38 combined tackles, six sacks, two forced fumbles and four fumble recoveries across 16 games.

Bailey joined the Falcons in July 2019 on a two-year contract worth $10.5 million. He appeared in 31 games over two seasons with Atlanta before the organization released him on February 18, 2021, bringing his NFL career to a close.

Across 133 regular-season appearances, Bailey recorded 248 combined tackles and 22 sacks. His career also included four forced fumbles and seven fumble recoveries, reflecting his contributions as a defensive end throughout his time in the league.

Bailey 's cause of death has been described as natural causes by his family with no specific illness named.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes may soon notice a change in husband Patrick's mood as the Chiefs' schedule takes a brutal turn
articles.standfirst: It's been smoothing sailing for the Mahomes family and the Kansas City Chiefs up until now.
articles.summary: It's been smoothing sailing for the Mahomes family and the Kansas City Chiefs up until now.
articles.body:
Through five games, it's been kind of shocking how easy the Kansas City Chiefs have turned themselves around from a season ago. After going 6-11 in 2025 , and with Patrick Mahomes coming off of a major knee injury, there were real questions about whether the Chiefs dynasty had reached its end.

As we head into Week 7 of the 2026 season , the Chiefs sit atop the AFC with a 5-0 record. Mahomes has looked like his usual self, running back Kenneth Walker III looks like an MVP candidate, and Kansas City is playing complementary football on both sides of the ball. This has all led to a happy Patrick, which in turn has led to a happy Brittany Mahomes at home .

Everything is going right for the Mahomes family at the moment, after so much turmoil last season. But even though the vibes are sky-high right now, that could change very soon . The only caveat from the Chiefs' 5-0 start is that they have played some easy opponents; particularly the Indianapolis Colts , Miami Dolphins , and Los Angeles Chargers .

Kansas City Chiefs schedule is about to get much harder, with two road games against top defenses

The Chiefs' upcoming schedule is a mixed bag, but there are some heavy hitters on the horizon . Making matters worse is that the team's next two games are on the road, against two elite defenses that could make life hard on Mahomes . This is how the next 10 games will play out for Kansas City.

Week 7: at Seattle Seahawks (3-3)

Week 8: at Denver Broncos (4-2)

Week 9: vs. New York Jets (2-4)

Week 10: at Atlanta Falcons (2-4)

Week 11: vs. Arizona Cardinals (2-4)

Week 12: at Buffalo Bills (5-1)

Week 13: at Los Angeles Rams (2-4)

Week 14: at Cincinnati Bengals (3-2)

Week 15: vs. New England Patriots (4-2)

Week 16: vs. San Francisco 49ers (6-0)

Thankfully, the Chiefs get three relatively easy matchups after the next two weeks, but then they have to go on the road for three away games against high-level opponents . They then have to face two more strong teams before the final two weeks of the season.

The Chiefs haven't faced any type of adversity yet this season, but it's coming - possibly sooner than later.

articles.title: Taylor Swift couldn't hide her reaction when Jason Kelce woke Travis up at 7:30 in the morning: “This is messed up.”
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs tight end recounted on *New Heights* the unusual request his brother made first thing in the morning. Travis thought it was an emergency, but Jason just needed help at the gym.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs tight end recounted on *New Heights* the unusual request his brother made first thing in the morning. Travis thought it was an emergency, but Jason just needed help at the gym.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce had a much earlier wake-up call than expected, all because of Jason Kelce. The former Philadelphia Eagles player called his brother at 7:30 a.m. and, in a matter of seconds, went from worrying that something serious had happened to discovering a request that prompted an immediate reaction from Taylor.

The Kansas City Chiefs player himself recounted the scene during the October 21 episode of New Heights. "I got a call at 7:30 in the morning" , explained Travis, who said he initially imagined the worst-case scenario and even wondered if he’d have to take Jason to the hospital. Not at all: his brother just wanted him to come downstairs to help him while he was lifting weights.

Taylor Swift’s reaction when Travis walked out of the room

Jason was staying with Travis and Taylor in Kansas City and had taken his workout routine very seriously. In fact, he was participating in “Squatober,” a workout challenge throughout October, and had even brought along two 25-pound weight plates so he could continue his sessions while traveling.

The problem arose when he needed someone to spot him during a bench press. Instead of waiting until a more reasonable hour, he picked up the phone and called Travis directly.

“Can you come help me?” was, in essence, the request the Chiefs player received. Travis agreed, but when he got out of bed, he got a much less enthusiastic response from Taylor: “This is messed up,” he recalled with a laugh on the podcast.

The situation seemed even more absurd to Travis because the call had initially set off all his alarm bells. At that hour, with Jason under the same roof, his first reaction was to think that something serious might have happened.

In the end, it all came down to his brother’s obsession with sticking to his workout routine. Jason had traveled to Kansas City to attend a New Heights event held near Arrowhead Stadium, ahead of the game between the Chiefs and the Los Angeles Chargers.

The story ended up becoming another one of those family moments that Travis and Jason often share on New Heights . This time, however, Taylor Swift ended up getting involved without even getting out of bed, and summed up what she thought of the Kelce brothers’ unexpected gym session in just four words.

articles.title: Former NFL player puts the Chiefs back in the center of the refereeing controversy: “Arrowhead Stadium is the most rigged venue”
articles.standfirst: Breiden Fehoko played in the NFL from 2020-2024
articles.summary: Breiden Fehoko played in the NFL from 2020-2024
articles.body:
Breiden Fehoko has reignited debate over officiating involving the Kansas City Chiefs , alleging that referees have given the team favorable treatment as the former nose tackle has pointed to experiences during his playing career to explain why he believes opponents anticipate controversial calls at Arrowhead Stadium . Fehoko made his criticism public on X.com, formerly known as Twitter, describing the Chiefs ' home ground in stark terms as his accusation has renewed discussion about disputed decisions involving Kansas City .

"Playing at Arrowhead Stadium is the most rigged venue in professional sports since Tom Brady left Foxborough," Fehoko said. "It has become a joke, and I believe players who have competed against the Kansas City Chiefs know exactly what I'm talking about. "Throughout my NFL career, we would have meetings with officials, and coaches would remind us to prepare for the possibility of a call in this game that could shift the momentum in Kansas City's favor. “This wasn't something we simply ignored. It was something we discussed and prepared for. I believe the NFL has a history of giving favorable treatment to teams and players who represent its biggest markets and most valuable storylines." The Chiefs ' high-profile status has kept the franchise under scrutiny, with Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce perceived to be on the winning end of several controversial decisions. One prominent example came in Kansas City 's 26-25 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals during the 2024 season as with 48 seconds remaining, Mahomes attempted a deep pass toward Rashee Rice on fourth-and-16, but the ball fell incomplete after apparently being tipped. Officials subsequently penalized Bengals defensive back Daijahn Anthony for pass interference, extending the drive before Harrison Butker kicked the winning field goal. However, replay footage shows the officials on the field before the pass falls incomplete.

Studies do not support Fehoko’s allegations

Ultimately, penalty totals offer a different perspective on claims that Kansas City receives preferential treatment as according to StatMuse figures supplied in the source material, the Dallas Cowboys have accumulated 1000 penalties across the regular season and playoffs since 2018, compared with 991 for the Chiefs . Whilst ESPN's analysis also found Kansas City was penalized 126 times during the 2024 regular season, tied with the Tennessee Titans for the sixth-highest total in the league, equating to approximately 7.4 penalties per game, above the league average of 6.8. The Chiefs ' opponents received 95 penalties during the regular season as officials threw more flags against Kansas City than its opponents in 12 of 17 games, including penalties that were declined or offset. Those figures, however, do not capture every disputed missed call and the postseason figures differed as Kansas City received fewer penalties than its opponents in all three playoff games covered by the analysis, including the AFC Championship Game . The Chiefs were flagged three times compared with eight penalties against the Ravens however Mahomes had secured an early lead and managed the game in the second half, whilst Baltimore were chasing the game and their season. Those results alone cannot establish bias, particularly given the limited postseason sample and over 17 playoff games across six seasons, Kansas City recorded fewer penalties in two of its three losses. Meanwhile Super Bowl LV defeat to Tampa Bay featured 13 penalties against the Chiefs and four against the Buccaneers , meaning Fehoko 's allegations therefore remain a matter of opinion.

articles.title: Tay's surprise gift: Travis Kelce reveals heartwarming “benefit” of marrying Taylor Swift
articles.standfirst: The NFL champion has revealed why strangers now approach him with heartwarming stories about their families
articles.summary: The NFL champion has revealed why strangers now approach him with heartwarming stories about their families
articles.body:
The influence of Taylor Swift on the NFL has been discussed extensively since she began dating Travis Kelce in 2023, but the Kansas City Chiefs star believes one of its most meaningful effects has received far less attention.

Rather than focusing on television ratings or the growing popularity of Chiefs merchandise, Kelce has discovered that his relationship with Swift has helped families find a new reason to spend time together.

The 37-year-old shared the observation during Wednesday's episode of the New Heights podcast, explaining that strangers frequently approach him to describe how football has strengthened their relationships with their daughters.

What began as a high-profile romance has introduced a new generation of supporters to the sport, with Kelce admitting that he never anticipated such a personal response.

The conversation began when Jason Kelce , Travis' older brother and a former Philadelphia Eagles center, asked how much the Chiefs ' fanbase had grown since Swift entered the picture.

Travis initially struggled to find the right words, before explaining that many of his interactions with supporters now involve something more personal than football results.

"Expressing their stories of them and their daughters having a moment of watching football together," Kelce said.

"And that has been undoubtedly the majority of people that come up to me that talk football just off the street."

The three-time Super Bowl champion explained that parents regularly thank him for helping create an unexpected connection with their children.

"I didn't have that one on the guard when I started dating Tay, let alone asked her to marry me, but it's been pretty cool to see the influx of Chiefs fans outside of all the Super Bowl appearances and all that," Travis added.

His comments reflected a side of Swift 's growing association with football that cannot be measured simply through audience figures.

Swift's football knowledge surprised Travis

Swift 's enthusiasm for the NFL has also developed considerably since her relationship with the Chiefs tight end began.

During a September episode of New Heights, Travis revealed that his wife had become increasingly confident in identifying penalties and understanding the finer details of the game.

"Now she knows everything," he said. "She sees the flags coming in. Like, 'Oh, that might be a defensive hold.' Like, 'What'd you say, sweetie?' She's like, 'That's encroachment.'"

Jason similarly recalled how interested Swift had been in learning about football when they spent time together at a Buffalo Bills game.

Swift and Kelce continue NFL connection

The couple married at Madison Square Garden on July 3, 2026, following their engagement in August 2025.

Swift has continued supporting her husband at Chiefs games, attending Kansas City's victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on October 18.

Her regular appearances have introduced football to audiences who might previously have had little interest in the NFL.

However, Kelce 's latest comments suggest that the most memorable consequence of their relationship has been the stories he hears from ordinary families.

While his career has delivered championships and individual honors, helping parents and children discover a shared passion has become an unexpected source of satisfaction.

articles.title: Expert reveals the truth behind Taylor Swift’s alleged fan confrontation at Chiefs game
articles.standfirst: A viral video sparked debate over Taylor Swift’s interaction with a fan at the Chiefs game, but a body language expert says the moment was not what many believed.
articles.summary: A viral video sparked debate over Taylor Swift’s interaction with a fan at the Chiefs game, but a body language expert says the moment was not what many believed.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift’s interaction with a fan during the Kansas City Chiefs ’ game against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday, October 18, sparked controversy on social media after a video showed the singer making a gesture toward someone recording her near her suite.

Some users interpreted the 36-year-old singer’s reaction as a sign of frustration toward the fan. However, celebrity body language expert Inbaal Honigman offered a different perspective on the viral moment.

According to Honigman, Taylor Swift initially displayed signs of discomfort but later realized the person recording her did not have bad intentions.

“The interaction between Swift and the fan is good-natured rather than antagonistic, even though the singer felt somewhat nervous,” Honigman explained in comments provided to Casino.org .

The moment took place while Swift was watching her partner, Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce , from a VIP suite at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City , Missouri.

Expert breaks down Taylor Swift’s body language in viral video

Honigman analyzed Swift’s movements as the fan approached the suite area and began recording the singer.

“When Taylor first spots the fan, her shoulders are raised and curled forward. This stance shows tension, and as her hands are gathered in front of her protectively, even anxiety,” Honigman said.

“The singer’s head is inclined forward as she tries to keep her mind and eyes on the game, but her physical form reveals that she is anxious.”

The expert suggested Swift may have initially been unsure about the person’s intentions.

“She could be worried in case this is not a fan but an agitator, someone with bad intentions,” Honigman explained.

However, she emphasized that Swift’s gestures did not appear to show anger.

“When she is seen gesturing for the fan to focus on the game, her movements do not appear annoyed; if they were, they would have been shorter and quicker.”

“Instead, Taylor points toward the field using her entire arm and hand, giving the fan a lot of attention, and then turns forward again while smiling.”

Honigman also pointed to Swift’s facial expression after the interaction.

“Her little grin is kind of flattered. It would appear that, once she made eye contact with the fan, she could see that it was not an agitator, but simply someone filming her without bad intentions.”

The expert clarified that her analysis is based only on Swift’s visible movements and that she cannot determine exactly what the singer was thinking during the interaction.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes knows the end is near for legendary Travis Kelce duo
articles.standfirst: The end of the Mahomes-Kelce era could be approaching, and the Chiefs quarterback opened up about the connection that made them unstoppable.
articles.summary: The end of the Mahomes-Kelce era could be approaching, and the Chiefs quarterback opened up about the connection that made them unstoppable.
articles.body:
The star of the Kansas City Chiefs , Patrick Mahomes , understands that the historic connection he has built with Travis Kelce could be entering its final chapters, a possibility the quarterback has acknowledged in recent years.

While there is no certainty that Kelce will retire from the NFL after this season, the reality is that the Kansas City tight end is at a different stage of his career. At 37 years old, newly married, with three Super Bowl titles and several lucrative opportunities waiting for him away from football, the veteran’s future remains uncertain.

But as long as they continue sharing the field, Mahomes and Kelce maintain a connection that few duos in league history have been able to build. After so many years working and winning together, they have developed a sixth sense that allows them to anticipate each other’s moves and see the game from the other’s perspective.

Mahomes discussed that special chemistry during his Wednesday, October 21 press conference.

“It started in training camp that first year I was starting. After every series he would ask me what I was seeing, why I wanted to throw it here,” Mahomes said. “Through those conversations, I started understanding what he was seeing. Now he’s able to do a lot of freelancing in the offense because we are on the same page.”

Travis Kelce remains the Chiefs’ top receiving weapon

Kelce, a 11-time Pro Bowl selection, continues to prove he remains a vital piece of Kansas City’s offense.

The tight end leads the team in receiving yards during the Chiefs’ undefeated start, recording 20 receptions for 299 yards and two touchdowns this season.

Throughout his career, Kelce has totaled 1,100 receptions, 13,301 receiving yards and 84 touchdowns, numbers that have virtually secured his future induction into the Hall of Fame.

However, beyond individual accomplishments, Mahomes and Kelce are focused on making the most of what could be their final opportunity together to chase another championship. And so far, Kansas City looks like a legitimate contender.

One of the team’s biggest offseason moves was the addition of running back Kenneth Walker III . The running back leads the NFL in rushing yards after six weeks with 665 yards, despite playing one fewer game than many of his counterparts.

The Chiefs remain perfect at 5-0 after their Week 5 bye and returned to action with a victory over the Los Angeles Chargers at Arrowhead Stadium.

Their next challenge will come against the Seattle Seahawks , Walker’s former team, on Sunday, October 25 .

articles.title: Andy Reid’s possum story and Patrick Mahomes’ rookie memory honor former Chiefs DE Allen Bailey
articles.standfirst: Reid recalled Bailey’s hunting advice about possums on his morning commute, while Mahomes shared the story of their first meeting in Kansas City
articles.summary: Reid recalled Bailey’s hunting advice about possums on his morning commute, while Mahomes shared the story of their first meeting in Kansas City
articles.body:
T he Kansas City Chiefs are mourning former defensive end Allen Bailey, who died at 37. His wife found him at their Florida home on Tuesday, his brother told TMZ. The family believes Bailey died of natural causes, but no official cause had been released as of Wednesday.

Andy Reid opened his Wednesday news conference with a tribute, calling Bailey “one of my favorite players” and a “great kid.” Then the Chiefs coach shared a small, funny memory that showed how well he knew him.

Reid’s possum story captured Bailey’s outdoorsman side

On his morning drive, Reid would sometimes spot a possum and mention it to Bailey, an avid hunter. Bailey would tell him not to eat those possums because they fed on garbage and that he should look for the ones that ate chestnuts. Reid remembered Bailey as an outdoorsman who was also tough and dependable, giving an honest effort on every play.

Mahomes’ memory went back to the day he entered the Chiefs’ locker room after being drafted in 2017. Bailey was the first player he saw. The sight of the veteran defensive end made Mahomes think, “This isn’t the Big 12 anymore.” He said he still tells the story to quarterbacks every year.

Patrick Mahomes, who played two seasons alongside Bailey, called him a “glue guy” , a teammate who helped make everything work. He said former teammates had talked about how they could support Bailey’s family. The Chiefs also shared a tribute describing Bailey as an excellent teammate, a generous man and a kind soul.

Bailey spent eight seasons with Kansas City after the Chiefs drafted him in the third round out of the University of Miami in 2011. He finished his career with the Atlanta Falcons, recording 248 tackles and 22 sacks in 133 regular-season games.

articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce reveals the surprising impact Taylor Swift has had on Chiefs fans, admitting he never expected the NFL star power that came with their relationship.
articles.summary: Travis Kelce reveals the surprising impact Taylor Swift has had on Chiefs fans, admitting he never expected the NFL star power that came with their relationship.
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce acknowledges the enormous impact Taylor Swift has had on Kansas City Chiefs fans and on the way many people have connected with football.

The Chiefs tight end explained that he has heard numerous stories from fans about how Swift’s presence has allowed them to share special moments watching NFL games with their families.

During the October 21 episode of New Heights , a follower asked: “How many Chiefs fans have come because of Taylor?”

“I will say this. I have a lot more people coming up to me expressing their stories of them and their daughters having a moment of watching football together,” Travis said to co-host Jason Kelce . “And that has been undoubtedly the majority of people that come up to me that talk football, just off the street.”

Kelce also admitted he never imagined the reach his relationship with the singer would have.

“I get a lot of thanks for that, which is just pretty cool. I didn’t have that one on the card when I started dating Tay, let alone asked her to marry me. But it’s been pretty cool to see the influx of Chiefs fans.”

The Taylor Swift phenomenon transformed Chiefs fandom

Swift’s influence in Kansas City has gone far beyond social media and become a phenomenon that has boosted the franchise’s popularity.

During the October 21 episode of New Heights , a follower asked: “How many Chiefs fans have come because of Taylor?”

“I will say this.
